launches.title: Proliferate: the open source company coding agent
launches.tagline: Build yourself an AI coworker that actually takes work off your plate
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Local coding agents can't do real end-to-end work at your company. Proliferate is the open-source, self-hostable platform for building company-specific background agents that can. Agents get their own sandboxes with secure access to your internal services, trigger from any event, and expose a live, multiplayer preview so your team can verify the work together. MIT licensed.

**Star the repo:** <https://github.com/proliferate-ai/proliferate>

**Get started self-hosting:** <https://docs.proliferate.com/>

**Sign up for self-serve waitlist:** <https://proliferate.com/waitlist>

**The Problem**

Coding agents today hit a wall the second they need to do real work. Fixing an actual bug means querying your staging database, reading internal Datadog logs, hitting proprietary APIs. You can't hand those keys to a generic cloud SaaS agent.

So you run agents locally. But that ties up your machine, forces you to babysit a terminal, and traps all the context on your laptop where nobody else can see it.

The most forward-looking engineering orgs- Stripe, Ramp, coinbase- spent months building custom infrastructure to solve this. Some are now merging 50+% of their PRs with agents.

Proliferate open-sources that infrastructure so every team can do the same.

**What teams use Proliferate for:**

* **On-call triage:** Sentry exception fires → agent reproduces the issue in a cloud sandbox → writes a fix → shares a live preview link in Slack for the team to verify.
* **Flaky test sweeps:** Cron job runs overnight → agent isolates flaky CI tests by running them 1,000x → PR is waiting by morning.
* **Mass migrations:** Bump React versions or internal API contracts across 50 microservices and fix the resulting breaking changes- automatically.
* **Team verification:** Agent gets a feature 80% done. Instead of reading the diff, the team clicks a live preview URL. A developer jumps into the shared terminal to fix the last failing test. Feature is merged.

**Demo: [https://youtu.be/H84HrOJx4QM](https://youtu.be/H84HrOJx4QM)**

**What makes it different**

Every agent gets its own sandbox with your Docker containers running, secure access to your internal services via our action catalog, and can be configured to respond to any trigger. Your code and data stay in your control- fully self-hostable, MIT licensed.

Another large difference comes with how your team interacts with the work. Reading AI-generated code is tedious. So every session produces a live UR. Sessions are multiplayer. Anyone on the team can jump in, check logs, or steer the agent in real-time.

**Our ask:** ⭐ Star the repo- we just open-sourced it. <https://github.com/proliferate-ai/proliferate>

If you're tired of handholding local agents and want to move them to the background with real infrastructure access, reach out. We're working closely with a handful of teams to help improve their engineering velocity and adoption of AI. [Book a demo](https://cal.com/team/proliferate/demo) or email [pablo@proliferate.com](mailto:pablo@proliferate.com).

launches.tagline: Just describe what you want and watch the automation build itself
launches.body:
Hey! We’re[ Tom](https://www.linkedin.com/in/t-greenwald/) and[ Anders](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anders-lie/), founders of[ Sidekick](https://joinsidekick.com).

**TL;DR:**

Teams in sales, marketing, and ops often turn to platforms like Zapier to automate their busywork. But these platforms are too complex and time-consuming for them. Sidekick replaces the steep learning curve with a simple chat interface, making powerful automation accessible to everyone.

https://youtu.be/K3nd9Ybxux4

**Problem:** Automation platform interfaces are outdated, drowning technical and non-technical users alike in complexity

For anyone in sales, marketing, or ops who wants to build an automation, the options are frustrating:

1. **Struggle for hours** to build a watered-down version of what you actually need
2. **Lose days (or weeks) you don’t have** trying to master a complex platform
3. **Wait for a technical teammate** to find time in their packed schedule to build it for you
4. **Hire an outside agency** that lacks the internal context to build it right

Even those with technical know-how end up wasting hours wrestling with these platforms, often just to hit a dead end.

**Solution:** Sidekick enables anyone on your team to build powerful automations just by chatting

Start by describing what it is you want:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93065&key=user_uploads/2033744/790bb2f5-b1af-4488-9749-eb9b3b2b424b)

Then watch the workflow build itself on the canvas:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93065&key=user_uploads/2033744/bc41e455-c816-4314-a0fe-1da88123c749)

Click run to see it live:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93065&key=user_uploads/2033744/db4cb6d4-5b17-44ba-8775-093b42e58a0f)

Or schedule it to run at some cadence:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93065&key=user_uploads/2033744/780700a5-3bdd-448a-8bfd-ed4ec412b3d5)

Instead of tangled flowcharts and endless dropdowns, you build in a simple side-by-side interface. The chat on the left is your input, and on the right, a live visual of your workflow is generated as the output. You build and modify the entire automation just by typing in the chat.

The result: Automation is finally accessible to the team members who need it most, while also giving technical pros a dramatically faster way to build.

We're starting with a robust suite of first-party integrations:

* **Google Suite** (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)
* **HubSpot**
* **Notion**
* **Linear**
* **AI calls** and **web scraping**

Here are 3 examples of what you can build with Sidekick:

* **Sync Gmail with Sheets:** Search for emails matching a certain criteria and feed them into new rows in Sheets
  * Apps: Gmail, Google Sheets
* **Daily Sales Briefing:** Analyze calendar meetings, research prospects with AI, and deliver insights via Slack each morning
  * Apps: Google Calendar, Web Scraping, AI, Slack
* **Weekly Pipeline Review:** Analyze all HubSpot deals with AI to identify pipeline risks and send weekly team reports via email
  * Apps: HubSpot, AI, Gmail

Get started for free at[ joinsidekick.com](https://joinsidekick.com)

Have a use case you want to chat through? Reach out to Tom at [tom@joinsidekick.com](mailto:tom@joinsidekick.com)

launches.body:
# **Hi!**

We’re **Moncef DJAFRI** and **Mariem Ould Ismail** from 🇫🇷 Paris, and we’re building **Stockline**.

---

# **TL;DR**

**Stockline** is an **AI-native ERP** for food wholesalers — automating manual order entry and replacing their clunky software from the 90s.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92425&key=user_uploads/2131140/29e05c95-954b-4073-9a4c-32fa93e0e7a2)

---

# **WHY WE CARE**

Mariem’s father is a fish wholesaler. 🐟 Back in high school, she spent her summers helping him — and watched him waste hours every day retyping orders, chasing invoices, and drowning in paperwork. ✏️

That’s where the idea was born.

Mariem and Moncef met at **École Polytechnique** in France, where we went through years of military training, rigorous math, and team projects.

We were both admitted to **MIT** and **Stanford**, but chose to focus on **Stockline’s mission**: bringing tech to an industry long overlooked by digital transformation.

---

# **THE PROBLEM**

Most food wholesalers still rely on software from the 90s.

One symptom among many: **Orders come in through WhatsApp, SMS, email, or phone calls — and get retyped manually into their ERP.**

Admin work takes over.\
Headcount grows just to keep up with repetitive tasks.\
From quoting to delivery, everything is **manual, error-prone, and slow**.

They barely use data. **Prices are set by instinct**, with no visibility into stock or margins. And most tools out there just don’t match how they actually work.

This leads to:\
→ Mistakes\
→ Tight margins\
→ Food waste

---

# **THE SOLUTION**

**Stockline replaces outdated ERPs with AI at the core.** The game-changer? **No more manual data entry**.

Our AI captures orders from every channel — **WhatsApp, SMS, email, even phone calls** — and feeds them straight into one unified system.

We centralize:\
• Communication (WhatsApp, emails, SMS…)\
• Operations (billing, inventory, CRM…)

**All in one platform. Admin disappears.**

Once you have all the data in one interface, the sky’s the limit! And the broader vision is to rethink ERPs entirely so that wholesalers finally get to focus on what really matters:\
→ Their products\
→ Their customers\
→ Their margins

https://youtu.be/TsbPuwGhZhs?si=u5U0orZ_aIgIVbJE

# **OUR ASK**

👀 **Intros in the US or EU**\
Know **a food wholesaler, supplier, restaurant, supplier, fish market, butcher, supermarket**…?\
An intro would mean a lot.

🧠 \*\*ERP experience?\*\*\
If you’ve worked with ERPs or know the market (Europe or US), we’d love to chat.

Let’s fix food logistics together!

📧 **Email us:** [contact@stockline.ai](mailto:contact@stockline.ai)

📱 **Text us:** +1 627 268 9935 // 0033 652266829 (WhatsApp)

💻 **Ask for a demo**: https://stockline.ai

launches.title: Kestroll 🎬 AI-powered media asset management
launches.tagline: Search terabytes of video and photo archives for the exact moment.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We are Tom and Ben, the cofounders of Kestroll.

**TL;DR**

Kestroll is an **AI-powered media asset management platform** that automatically logs and organizes media assets (photos, audio, and especially videos), making terabytes of content easily searchable and instantly distributable.

**The Problem**

Imagine you’re a filmmaker working on a feature-length movie, a creative producer at a professional sports team, or a digital asset manager at an enterprise.

**For every hour of content, you must spend 3-5 hours watching it back and labeling it**. Even for labeled content, you will likely still have to rewatch again to find niche or specific moments that you didn’t explicitly label. And let’s not forget that people from other teams and departments will be constantly pinging you for specific shots they need.

In short, the logging process is tedious, the search experience sucks, and distribution is a bottleneck.

**Introducing Kestroll…**

[**https://youtu.be/iXUkRBFOL0w?si=JOtetl3RhWbvw1Pe**](https://youtu.be/iXUkRBFOL0w?si=9OYcXXKY2DcLSrT8)

Kestroll integrates with any media storage solution(s) (cloud, NAS, SAN, hard drives), making the following possible across terabytes of content:

* Search for content via natural language, based on visual cues, abstract concepts, or creative intent
* Access all media content from one interface for your entire team
* Share content via links, instead of shipping hard drives or walking them down the hall to another department (yes, people actually do that)
* Pull content found on Kestroll directly into the editing platform (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Lightroom, etc.)

**Who we are**

We met in our freshman year, built one of the largest student-run startup accelerators in Boston during our sophomore year, and cofounded an AI language tutor in our senior year. Before building Kestroll, Ben worked as a founding engineer and Tom as a founding sales at seed-stage YC companies. Tom is also a videographer and felt this problem personally.

launches.tagline: Pangolin tunnels your services to the internet so you can access anything from anywhere.
launches.body:
**TL;DR: [Pangolin](https://digpangolin.com) is an [open-source](https://github.com/fosrl/pangolin) cloud and self-hostable alternative to Cloudflare Tunnels, Zscaler ZPA, and Ngrok. Pangolin provides a simple way to securely expose applications on private networks with identity-aware access control and high availability.**

We’ve seen incredible early traction since we launched 5 months ago: **12,600+ GitHub stars, 140,000+ installs, 2,700+ Discord members**. 

https://youtu.be/0nv91PgCm9M

"Pangolin isn't just a fantastically easy-to-configure VPN and reverse proxy; it's a revelation in self-hosting simplicity." XDA Developers

**The problem:**

Providing users with secure access to internal tools and infrastructure is cumbersome for both end users and administrators. They're forced to manage complex VPN clients, servers, and network configurations that create friction and operational overhead. Traditional and mesh VPN approaches require layered ACL management to control which users can access specific resources, turning simple access requests into complex network engineering problems.

**Our solution:**

Drop in the Pangolin connector in your network, and:

* **Expose anything to the internet:** Instantly create a secure tunnel with your domain and SSL to internal dashboards like Grafana, or any other services on your private network and access via web browsers.
* **Manage access control with ease:** Grant access to your resources with user and role-based permissions, PIN codes, temporary share links, or email OTPs. Bring your existing users by integrating an external identity provider.
* **Own your infrastructure:** Self-host your own Pangolin Nodes, so data flows through your servers, and our cloud will handle coordination and failover for out-of-the-box high availability.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfMGfOAnChfvZ2vFva0IbL-s3dj1O50IP8cfgGf7h9IDz3ViH_tHbtHEwr_bdecGPerQPY-HSRMtoRLmJew9IlaQqpQQY_1JJBluOAEKCqsWjvusZMgy_9Y5FPVvjo68nGNaZ0Uig?key=2GXukewhPJ8smnttAaub3w)

"A self-hosted version of Cloudflare Tunnels on your terms. By your terms, I mean on the infrastructure of your choice." Lawrence Systems

**Deployment options:**

* **Enterprise:** Self-host the entire system on-premises with complete control over all system components.
* **Hybrid:** Self-host Pangolin Nodes on internal infrastructure while leveraging our cloud service for automatic failover coordination.
* **Cloud:** Fully managed service where organizations only run network connectors to expose resources.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc8cH83Sxqj5M57XuqQm_sofqW-Qn1sfTvTEsaTg4xYVAfRh_33XNMI8QDJrqibWqIQNVLLFHBob1vASk5ZnaX8KF5nZfY2eXYOwMp-n9UzOzyEHQUiocK89KT8izCeFG1CaEJ5xA?key=2GXukewhPJ8smnttAaub3w)

**Get started:**

* Website:[ https://digpangolin.com](https://digpangolin.com)

"Its streamlined deployment has left janky WireGuard configurations and Cloudflare tunnels in its dust." [selfh.st](http://selfh.st)

We are Owen and Milo Schwartz (brothers) who previously worked together as founding engineers at a successful smart mobility startup, working on connectivity and automation solutions for public infrastructure. We are passionate about building the next generation of simple networking tools.

launches.body:
Hey everyone we’re Harsha and Dhruv from Slashy. Our goal is to define the next generation of email, by building an email platform that actually works for you, and learns over time. \
\
**TLDR:** Slashy is the next big email platform after Superhuman, the first with an assistant built in. Slashy can do everything from writing drafts in your tone, texting you when an important email comes in, prepping you for calls, to the things you expect from a true email client like keyboard shortcuts, open tracking, a mobile app and more. All while continuously learning about you and your preferences, so it only gets better over time. The average user takes 5 minutes to get set up and saves an extra hour a day. Read an independent review from Tom’s guide (1m+ subscribers) [here](https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/slashy-is-the-ai-email-app-replacing-notion-mail-heres-why).

You can get started for free at [slashy.com](http://slashy.com), and use our YC deal for a long-term discount.

**Launch Video:** <https://youtu.be/o2TN-wwCYm8>

## **Problem**

Most founders we speak to, have one of two problems (sometimes both)

1. They spend too much time manually handling email, and not enough building their company.
2. They don’t spend enough time on email, and lose important deals/hires due to things slipping.

## **Solution**

That’s why we built Slashy, the first email platform that reliably gets work done for you, whether it be drafting emails, notifying you when a prospect replies, schedule meetings, or more. Slashy works wherever you work best, so onboarding is seamless (just ask some of our users). It takes 10 minutes to set up, and saves the average email power user an extra one hour a day. It does this by:

1. **Doing all the basic things right:** Stuff like keyboard shortcuts, open tracking, unified inbox, team comments, availability links, all come part of Slashy. So you don’t lose anything transitioning from Gmail, Superhuman, Front and more. ([@Jayme Hoffman](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/60463) actually switched to Slashy being surprised just that a new email client could match the speed, shortcuts of something like Superhuman)
2. **Writing drafts that sound like you:** Claude drafts sound like slop because they just look at the thread. Slashy does a lot more, it looks at the linkedin/web of recipients, past emails you’ve sent, past changes you’ve made to prior drafts, and more including using our own custom-built memory system for email. (Fun fact we have a special tool for handling suggesting times/scheduling as base llms are very bad at this). ([@Michelle Marcelline](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/379052) pretty much just hits send on all her Slashy drafts with minimal edits)
3. **A powerful sidebar:** Slashy comes with a cursor-like sidebar. That lets you do things like search, draft, schedule and more. So you no longer need to keep flipping between ChatGPT and your email. ([@Yahia Bakour](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2538368) loves this to power thorugh drafts and replies)
4. **Integrations:** Slashy connects to not just your email, but your meeting notes (Granola, Fathom, Circleback, etc.), crm (Attio, Hubspot, Salesforce, etc.), Notion and more since the context to handle email isn’t just in email. ([@Pavlos Markesinis](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2511438) loves how Slashy connects to his Attio and makes life simple)
5. **Automations:** The best assistants also know when to handle things in the background. So Slashy can also automatically do things like prep you for calls, text you when an important email comes in, and more. ([@Owen Botkin](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2579867) relies on Slashy to prep him from calls, and [@Pranav Madhukar](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1531197) doesn’t even check his email anymore unless Slashy alerts him an email comes in)
6. **iMessage/Slack Bot:** One of the worst parts of traditional clients? You need to open them to see if something important comes in. Slashy can ping you on text/slack so you don’t even need to context switch. (@devansh is one of our bigger Slack fans, while [@Abhinav Gopal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/979064) for iMessage).
7. **Voice:** Sometimes it’s easier to speak your mind than write (or you’re driving and just can’t haha). So Slashy lets you dictate your thoughts, and our AI will make it sound like a much better version of you. Or you can talk with our voice to voice agent when you’re commuting (@vishruth is one of our power users for our voice drafts).
8. **Personalized Memory:** Slashy gets better the more you use it. It keeps notes on how you write, who you talk to, when you schedule, and also it learns from every edit you made before hitting send. It even once a week goes back and rewrites its notes to better match you. After all you'd expect a human assistant to be smarter after a few months, why not your ai one. ([@Devraj Gopal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2057015) loves how Slashy has grown to know him more and more).
9. **Natural Language Labels:** A common complaint we hear is the rise of the AI SDR, and how everyone’s inbox is inundated with emails. The problem with traditional labelling systems is they don’t adjust over time, leading to important emails getting missed. Slashy’s labelling system does, leading to a much better filtering rate, and fewer dropped balls. ([@Nazli Danis](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/520906) was drowning in spam before Slashy)

## Security and Privacy

We take security/privacy as an email client very seriously.  We’ve already gotten CASA, and SOC II. We also get monthly pen-tests done by [@Casco](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/30477) to ensure our users' data is safe. None of our AI providers train on your data as well.

## Getting Started

Now if you want to get started just go to[ slashy.com](http://slashy.com), or you can book a time here if you’d like me to demo the product/ask any questions just shoot an email to [founders+ea@slashy.com](mailto:founders+ea@slashy.com), and Slashy will schedule a time that works for both of us :)

launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93051&key=user_uploads/1742167/37a5da06-50ca-423f-9bcb-f0ca21e16254)

**TL;DR**

Before editing even starts, professional video-production teams spend days just preparing footage — copying files, syncing audio, creating proxies, and organizing footage. For big shoots, this can eat nearly half the project’s time and budget.

CoCreate is an AI-native tool that does all of that in the background while you back up your footage, so by the time your card is copied, it’s already synced, proxied, organized, and ready to edit in Premiere, Avid, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve.

If you work with large volumes of footage, we’d love to onboard you as an early user, connect with assistant editors, post supervisors, or DITs you know, and get your feedback on our demo.

**Problem**

Media prep is the slowest part of post-production. Professional video teams juggle multiple tools to back up, sync, proxy, and organize — a process that’s repetitive, error-prone, and can consume 40% of a project’s time and budget. Existing tools fail at solving this core issue.

**Solution**

\
CoCreate is an AI-native video editing and media organization tool that gets professional video editors from SD card to edit as fast as possible. CoCreate works in parallel during backup: we checksum your files for safety, automatically sync audio with video, create proxies, and organize footage by scene, take, date, camera, and person. The result: **weeks** of prep work done in **minutes**, with everything searchable, and exportable in your preferred format.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93051&key=user_uploads/1742167/95b007b5-884d-41f2-aab6-6bee44c19ef7)

**Check out our demo:** https://youtu.be/zL4gAKHMHyo

**Who it’s for**

We’re built for high quality video production teams — from massive YouTubers and indie shoots to large-scale post houses — who deal with large volumes of footage and need to move faster without sacrificing quality or safety. 

**Our backstory**

Tamish and Sid first met during New Student Orientation at Stanford three years ago and quickly became close friends. A year later, Archish transferred to Stanford and was introduced to them through the university’s vibrant music scene. The three clicked instantly — not just as musicians playing campus shows together, but also as classmates grinding through late-night problem sets as CS majors.

All three had been creating music and video content for years before Stanford, and they kept that momentum going on campus — producing projects that have collectively garnered millions of views across platforms. That blend of long-standing creative experience and technical expertise made them deeply familiar with the pain points of media production, ultimately inspiring them to build **cocreate** to make high-volume post-production faster, simpler, and more collaborative.

**Our ask to the YC community:**

* **Post houses / production teams** — if you handle lots of footage, we’d love to onboard you as early users.
* **Introductions** to assistant editors, post supervisors, or DITs you know.
* **Feedback** on our product demo — especially from those with experience in high-volume video workflows.

If you can help us with any of this, please reach out at [founders@cocreate.so](mailto:founders@cocreate.so).

Thank you!

launches.title: 💻 AgentHub 📈 - The Staging Environment for your AI Agents
launches.tagline: Simulate, trace, and evaluate agent behavior in real-world environments
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

AgentHub is an implementation-agnostic platform for evaluating AI agents in realistic simulation environment sandboxes. Use cases that we support include computer-use, browser, conversational, and tool-use agents. We help teams test, trace, track, and improve agent behavior at scale before deployment, closing the gap between vibe checks and real-world performance.

👉 Check us out [AgentHubLabs.com](http://AgentHubLabs.com)

💬 If you’re building agents, training models, or can connect us to someone who is, we’d love to [chat](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ1FO0fw7yHEhAAHWoiyCOS2umxQTuat9bIUwOOzomfV4D8bxhKakigP0nglXPAQh-4qvrYwukiM)!

---

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1gPVYcphmmY

### **🧩 The Problem**

LLM-based agents often **pass simple evals at a small scale and in specific cases** but **fail in deployment**. They hallucinate tool use, misuse APIs, or follow an inefficient (or incorrect) reasoning trajectory that isn’t captured in standard benchmarks. There’s no standard way to evaluate agents beyond prompt-based tests - especially across **tool use**, **UI interactions**, and **multi-step reasoning**.

---

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92664&key=user_uploads/1435098/77c2d173-7349-41e4-90a2-e2b69712ede5)

### **✅ The Solution: AgentHub**

AgentHub lets you **simulate real-world environments** and **evaluate agents end-to-end** using structured tasks, traces, and grading:

* 🧪 **Multi-domain, customizable environments for**: e-commerce, CRM, filesystem, browser agents, dashboards, and more
* 🕵️ **Full tracing** in standardized OpenTelemetry format: capture every LLM/tool call, decision point, and UI step
* 📊 Evaluation that’s easy to plug and play: LLM, human-in-the-loop, and rule-based grading + custom metrics at the task, step, or tool level
* 🛠️ **Debug and iterate fast**: See exactly where agents fail, and improve reasoning or control loops
* 🧠 **Automated Insights**: Get automatic insights into failure modes and auto-generate suggested fixes

Whether you’re testing autonomous workflows, tool-using copilots, or browser agents, we give you a **sandboxed, realistic playground** to evaluate in before you ship.

---

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92664&key=user_uploads/1435098/a2b71d28-7310-4423-ac4d-1c717f244af4)

### **🕵️ Who We Are**

Youssef was previously a tech lead on the Foundation Model Evaluation team at Apple and studied CS at CMU.

Sandra has been an engineer at multiple startups, Google, and Meta, and studied CS and design at MIT.

We’ve been friends since a few years ago through a summer spent in Seattle and are obsessed with building the missing critical infrastructure to help teams **evaluate, debug, and trust** their agents.

launches.tagline: We empower cattle farmers with early disease detection and reproductive insights.
launches.body:
**TLDR:** Nexa builds implantable “FitBits” + AI for cattle monitoring. We empower farmers with early disease detection and reproductive insights that save them time and money.

https://youtu.be/goioQTngpSU

**Problem**

Efficiently monitoring cattle health and reproduction is critical to maintain farm profitability. But the traditional practice of manually inspecting animals doesn’t scale - labor costs add up, while farms miss disease outbreaks and breeding cycles. Disease alone causes \~$100 billion in losses yearly for cattle farms globally.

Existing tech for monitoring cattle includes external wearables like collars and ear-tags. Being outside thick cattle skin, these can’t accurately track useful biometrics beyond “activity” (a glorified step-count). There’s also boluses, pill-shaped devices that sit in the cow stomach. But these are super expensive, have short battery life, and can’t be used for beef cattle.

**Solution**

Nexa is building implantable microchips that go underneath the skin in the ear of cattle. We analyze vital biometrics - like temperature, heart rate, blood oxygen, activity, GPS location, and more - that other systems miss, to empower farmers with early disease detection and reproductive insights. And because our electronics operate at millimeter scale, we benefit from low production costs and pricing up to 70% cheaper than current solutions.

Our hardware also enables collection of the world’s largest cattle health dataset - so, we can develop foundation models that can unlock new possibilities in farm management and livestock pharma. 

We’re currently launching our dairy pilot program - if you know any dairy farmers based in the USA, please send them our way at [admin@nexa.farm](mailto:admin@nexa.farm) :)

**About Us**

We’re a team of Caltech dropouts with backgrounds in bioengineering, electrical engineering, CS, math, and physics. We want to build technology that makes a tangible impact on the lives of real people in America and beyond.

launches.title: BootLoop - AI Agent for Firmware & Embedded Software
launches.tagline: AI that writes, tests, and debugs firmware on real hardware in minutes.
launches.body:
## **TL;DR**

All modern hardware needs firmware but it’s expensive, time-consuming and bugs in the field can lead to multi-million dollar recalls. BootLoop is building an AI agent to deliver custom firmware, fully tested on your hardware, in minutes not months. Our team built the firmware for SpaceX’s Raptor engine from first fire to flight, made brain-computer interfaces at MIT, and is _embedding_ that experience into our agent.

**Ask:** Are you building hardware or do you know someone who is? Email us at [founders@bootloop.ai](mailto:founders@bootloop.ai) to be added to our pilot program. See below for details.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GBI1fkx5Bss

## **❌ The Problem**

All modern hardware needs firmware, but writing firmware is hard. It’s difficult to debug and tricky to validate and chip datasheets can reach upwards of 3000 pages. On top of that, there’s a shortage of qualified firmware engineers. As hardware gets more complex, the time and cost to write firmware for it goes up exponentially.

**The problems are staggering:**

* The hardware world is **incredibly fractured** - over 65 different major manufacturers, producing over 80,000 unique chips, each of which has different software stacks, different frameworks, and different capabilities
* Modern hardware requires sophisticated networking stacks, power optimization, and advanced security, driving up complexity
* Firmware engineers are hard to find - **you can't major in firmware engineering** - and even the most attractive engineering companies take up to **6 months to find a qualified engineer**

## **🤖 Our Solution**

We’re building an AI agent specifically for firmware and embedded software development, with the context and tooling needed to write low-level code and validate it on hardware in real-time.

**Key capabilities of our Agent:**

* **Deep hardware understanding:** Ingests your documentation, datasheets, schematics, system diagrams, existing codebases, and more…
* **Hardware interaction:** Talks directly with your boards and test equipment like oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers
* **Real testing:** Validates code on actual hardware or in simulation
* **Framework expertise:** Writes in your language and style using your preferred embedded frameworks and proprietary libraries
* **ITAR compliance:** The first ITAR-capable coding agent, opening massive aerospace and defense markets

**Pilot program:** Our team will work with you as forward-deployed engineers on a specific firmware problem. We’ll use our agent internally to deliver aerospace-grade code FAST, with a human validating every line. After the pilot, we’ll deploy your custom version of the BootLoop agent for your future firmware needs.

## **👥 The Team**

**Chris Markus (CTO)** - Former **lead software engineer for SpaceX's Starship booster catch system**. He also built SpaceX’s **Raptor engine firmware from first fire to flight**. Before SpaceX, he was a visiting researcher at MIT Media Lab designing EEG electronics and firmware lead for an FDA-authorized ventilator.

**Noah Pacik-Nelson (CEO)** - Formerly at Accenture’s AI Refinery, he **built agents for Fortune 500 companies**. Prior, he researched neuromorphic computing and ultra-low power edge AI at Accenture Labs. He has **patents and papers across AI adaptation, digital signal processing, and energy harvesting** and was a visiting researcher at the MIT Media Lab, building brain-computer interfaces for ALS patients.

## **🙏 Our Ask**

**If you're building hardware (or know someone who is), we'd love to add you to our pilot program.** Email us at [founders@bootloop.ai](mailto:founders@bootloop.ai) to get on the list.

During the pilot, we’ll create your firmware FAST, using the BootLoop agent internally while reviewing every line by hand to ensure it meets our rigorous standards.

**Currently Onboarding:**

* Deep tech companies
* Aerospace & defense contractors
* Medical device manufacturers
* Robotics companies
* IoT hardware developers

The nature of class action/mass torts involves thousands of cases for a single lawsuit. This data is extensive, granular, and buried deep in thousands of pages of medical, financial, and employment records and others.

Kalinda extracts, summarizes, and aggregates data from these records for attorneys with AI.

When scaled across an entire litigation, Kalinda works tirelessly and in parallel—turning a process that once took months into just a few hours. 

Kalinda provides firms with the equivalent manpower of hundreds of paralegals and legal nurses, allowing them to quickly determine which claimants are eligible and helping them file faster and in greater volume.

To date, we’ve processed 600k pages of records and are live with 2 of the largest plaintiff law firms in the U.S!

**TL;DR:** Kalinda helps class action law firms qualify potential cases in minutes with AI — giving plaintiff law firms the equivalent manpower of thousands of paralegals and legal nurses. 

Hey YC! We’re [Sayan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sayanbhatia/) and [Sohil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sohilbhatia/). We’re brothers and the co-founders of Kalinda.

---

---

---

---

---

---

**The Problem:**

* Millions of people every year join class action and mass tort lawsuits, hoping for justice and compensation. 
* For the law firm, this means verifying proof of usage and liability for each person—information often buried across thousands of pages of medical, pharmaceutical, and product records. 
* This compounds to several months of work for law firms just to determine who qualifies and who doesn’t.

**Our Solution:**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EaPmwze4G18

Kalinda…

* **Extracts** proof of use, proof of injury, and other critical data points
* **Aggregates** and correlates this data against lawsuit criteria
* **Generates** a single report so plaintiff attorneys instantly know if a case is valid to file

All while doing this for each case, _working tirelessly and in parallel_. 

When scaled across an entire litigation this turns a process that once took months into just a few hours.

As the lawsuit progresses and criteria change, we also help attorneys filter, categorize, and score to surface their strongest cases.

**Where we’re at:**  To date, we’ve processed 600k pages of records and are live with 2 of the largest plaintiff law firms in the U.S!

**The Why & The Vision:**

The plaintiff side of class actions and mass torts have struggled for decades now with what’s often called the [“Field of Dreams” problem](https://texaslawreview.org/multidistrict-litigation-and-the-field-of-dreams/). Thousands of clients sign up for a lawsuit looking for restitution - only to leave the law firm buried in records, missing deadlines, and filing bad cases. When courts throw out these bad cases, it weakens the plaintiff side’s leverage in settlement negotiations.

With Kalinda, class action & mass tort law firms can now file valid cases faster and file more of them — fundamentally changing for the first time in 172 years not only how many people can get justice against corporate negligence, but how fast it’s delivered.

**The Team:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93158&key=user_uploads/2232317/204e2640-94bc-464d-b0da-40f257ffc8d8)

* **Sayan (Co-founder & CEO) -** did AI research at UC Davis’s LUKA Lab in instruction tuning optimization. 
* **Sohil (Co-founder & CTO) -** did AI research at Pacific Northwest National Lab

We’ve been collaborators together since Day 1 and even co-founded and scaled a STEM non-profit together to 7000 students worldwide.

If you either have 

1. Been a part of a class action or mass tort in the past
2. Know a friend or family who’s been a part of a class action or mass tort 
3. Know any attorneys, paralegals, associates at class action/mass tort law firms.

Reach out at [founders@kalinda.ai](mailto:founders@kalinda.ai). We would love to chat!

launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We’re Aria & Tony, co-founders of Parachute – the end-to-end governance infrastructure that helps hospitals adopt AI safely and at scale. 

**TL;DR:** 

Parachute helps health systems evaluate, deploy, and monitor every AI tool they touch – whether it’s an Epic plug-in, vendor model, or in-house imaging model.

https://youtu.be/tRvaL0LaWOI?feature=shared

**Why we built this**

During our time spent deploying AI at Columbia University Irving Medical Center (CUIMC), we kept seeing the same issues:

* 2,000+ clinical AI tools have hit the market
* New rules (HTI-1, Colorado AI Act, CA SB 3030, White House AI Action Plan) demand auditable proof of safety, equity, and efficacy
* Lean IT teams can’t possibly vet and watch every model, and a single failure can cost lives and trigger seven-figure settlements

Great innovations die in pilot hell because the infrastructure to deploy AI tools simply does not exist.

That’s why we built Parachute and why CUIMC now uses it to track live models in real time.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfMeMr6DgcDfTSH91cRA9KtSS09A-U2M58jcX1CTXsbPw7Ud6BHvJcCpmNCjMdLr81Nsd2w887yyYtaGkNny9DtSgWATBs8qekupLkiRfuj4WlU33gbaf9u5hCBcgUypKIjh6yFlA?key=tv4NvQsH04_CHvpgP40CGw)

🪂 **How Parachute works** 

**1. Vendor discovery and vetting**\
AI agents map the hospital’s gaps and goals to the best AI tools on the market, while our review engine flags any compliance issues in vendor documentation.

**2. State-of-the-art benchmarking and evaluations**\
Our automated scoring and stress testing helps decision makers identify the best-fit options.

**3. Real-time observability**\
Once a tool is adopted, Parachute monitors it from inception through post-deployment. We automate real-time tracking of performance, drift, and bias – alerting you the moment any metric slips below threshold.

**4. Immutable audit trail**

Every approval, test, change, and runtime metric around a model is documented and audit-ready for regulators.

**Call to action**

Hospital leaders: Want stalled pilots live before 2026, access to the world’s best AI tools, an audit-proof evidence trail and hands-free monitoring? 

AI vendors: Want your product listed in the only marketplace that maps directly to hospital gaps and compliance needs?

Reach us at [founders@parachute-ai.com](mailto:founders@parachute-ai.com) or book a meeting [here](https://calendly.com/founders-parachute-ai/30min). 

For more information visit: [parachute-ai.com](http://parachute-ai.com)

launches.tagline: Trace helps teams map existing workflows and automate repetitive tasks using AI agents
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re [Tim](https://www.linkedin.com/in/timcherkasov/) and [Artur](https://www.linkedin.com/in/artur-romanov/) – co-founders of [Trace](https://www.trace.so/).

**📙 TL;DR**

Trace is a workflow automation platform that routes tasks to the right agent – human or AI.

By connecting to tools like Slack, Jira, and Notion, Trace breaks down existing workflows, spots automation opportunities, and embeds AI agents to handle repetitive tasks – without disrupting how your team works. More than 30 companies already use Trace to automate gruntwork.

**Ask**: If you’re currently working in operations, product, or support teams, we’d love to talk. Email us at [founders@trace.so](mailto:founders@trace.so) ‼️

https://youtu.be/RfJerH9r2-8

**❌ The Problem**

Most teams lose ≈ 40% of their productivity on repetitive manual tasks. 

Routine work like chasing updates, filling docs, coordinating teams, and handling support drains hours, breaks focus, and slows execution.

Meanwhile, employees aren’t sure which tasks can be automated, which agents to use, or which tools to trust – problems made worse by fragmented data and lost context.

Even worse, most AI tools work alone, disconnected from both teams and the people using them.

✅ **Our Solution** 

Trace is an AI-native workspace that breaks down existing workflows, assigns repetitive tasks to AI agents, and routes the rest to the right people.

With Trace, AI works across your entire team – passing tasks between agents and people without disrupting operations.

It respects permissions, learns from past and ongoing work, tracks progress with a full audit trail, and lets you review, edit, or reroute tasks in a simple interface.

**Connect and Prompt Away**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92892&key=user_uploads/1016719/794551f2-0e27-4ccf-a406-326622b90d15)

**Create, Curate and Replicate**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92892&key=user_uploads/1016719/75f7fd26-b38a-4420-b7dc-1a7fe5bea7e6)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92892&key=user_uploads/1016719/4490fdd4-1ff7-47dc-887b-cab413a3b51c)

**🦄 How It Works**

How? – Through a company wide context engine!

By integrating with your systems, our context engine analyzes your internal wiki, activity logs, and people data to understand your team’s work.

Trace then builds a unified index of your company and provides rich context for every new workflow, making it easy to route tasks between people and AI agents.

We’re on a mission to build CompanyOS – a cognitive layer that ingests internal signals and drives intelligent action across every team.

**🙏 Our Ask**

Ready to ditch the busywork? – Please try [demo.trace.so](http://demo.trace.so) for free and tell us which workflows you’ve tried to automate.

If your team is suffering from repetitive manual workflows, or you work in operations, product, or support roles, we’d love to talk.

Email us [📨 founders@trace.so](mailto:%F0%9F%93%A8founders@trace.so) or [book a call](https://calendly.com/trace_so/20min) ☎️

launches.title: Fulcrum: The Agentic Debugger for AI Systems
launches.tagline: Fulcrum - for those who are tired of being bullshitted by their agents
launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

We’re building the best software for debugging AI agents and their environments. If you’re building RL environments or deploying agents, get in touch with us and try out our product.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WXa-cGlg6E4

**The problem**\
Agents are incredibly complicated. Evals are a mess. We need to understand what our agents are capable of and if our RL environments even work.

**The solution**

Our monitoring system identifies why your agents don't succeed, uncovers bugs in your environment, and detects fake solutions, reward hacking, or catastrophic agent failures. Our redteaming agents run experiments to diagnose your agent issues. They plug into your environments, agent traces, and agent source code to find the root cause of your issues. Finally we take all of these investigations, and turn them into intuitive, explorable reports you can chat with.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93452&key=user_uploads/1059517/a3db8aa8-5dd2-4553-a943-ecb805d5861e)

\
\
**Who we are**\
We met at MIT where we were doing research on LLMs. In our latest paper we built a method for scalably generating software environments of arbitrary difficulty. Doing it ourselves gave us the know-how to build a great environment debugger. We have published at top ML conferences  (NeurIPS, CoLM) and built widely-used open source software (5k stars, >100k downloads). Our team has won a total of four medals at international olympiads in physics and economics.

**Call to action:**

Email us at [team@fulcrumresearch.ai](mailto:team@fulcrumresearch.ai) if you’re building environments or deploying agents, and share this around with people who are. Or [chat with us](https://cal.com/kaivu/30min)!

launches.title: b-12 - Chemistry Copilot for Pharma & Biotech
launches.tagline: Full Stack Chemistry Platform - from planning to robotic execution of experiments
launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

Drug discovery is slow, and it costs billions of dollars. The bottleneck in early discovery is chemical synthesis. b-12 is building a full stack of AI agents to deliver planning and robotic executions of experiments, in minutes, not months. **Our team has developed custom robots for chemistry (Chemspeed), orchestrated AI agents for lab control (EPFL & IBM), and is translating this into a powerful and easy-to-use product.**

**Ask:** Are you running chemistry experiments or chemical robots? Do you know someone who is? Email us at [founders@b12-labs.com](mailto:founders@b12-labs.com) to be added to our pilot program. See below for details.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qmf7q-Sie2o

# ❌ **The problem:**

**Drug Discovery is slow:**

* It takes 10+ years and over $2 billion to discover a new drug.
* 2 in 10000 compounds make it.
* Chemistry execution is very slow.

Experiments take time! Designing good experiments and trial and error in the lab are big factors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92473&key=user_uploads/2507050/0cd3f202-e48b-48da-a6e5-3ae1572cddab)

**Software for chemists is fragmented:**

* There are many solutions for many different parts of the pipeline.
* Tools are outdated, and integration is largely missing.

**Lab robots are underused:**

* Most lab robots are _not accessible to scientists_ because they are hard to use.
* Drag and drop software for multimillion-dollar robotic labs.
* Lab automation engineers are hard to find.

**Current State:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92473&key=user_uploads/2507050/2a3d91a0-8e78-44d9-a89c-f1dcc7b45f67)

**b-12:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92473&key=user_uploads/2507050/893d0cd2-d071-43be-b08e-ddf29b8aaddc)

# ✅ **Our** **Solution:**

We are integrating a full stack of Agents to **design experiments** and **write code for the robot** that runs these experiments, with the tools and context needed to predict chemically meaningful results, and close the experimental loop.\
\
**Key capabilities of our Agents:**

* **Streamline Experiment Planning**: Our tools accelerate creation of experimental details based on literature and expert tools, and tailor the output to the user’s specific needs.
* **Unified platform:** Our platform integrates several agents that are in tight communication and can go from natural language input to robotic execution in minutes.
* **No coding required - use natural language:** With arbitrary input flexibility, we can control the robot the same way you would talk to your lab-mates, including inputs from previous runs, and uploading relevant documents.
* **Parallel and scalable to any lab:** We are vendor agnostic, and integrate with different robotics (Chemspeed, Unchained, Opentrons, etc.) and labs performing experiments manually.

**Pilot Program:** Our team will work on integrating Agentic solutions tailored to your lab's specific problems, whether you use lab automation or not. We want to speed up molecular discovery.

# **👥 Our Team:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92473&key=user_uploads/2507050/92133d6c-ba4b-4722-9115-8c45405366aa)

We are Zlatko and Andres, and in the past, we have:

1. Worked with big pharma (Roche), Chemical Robotics ([**Chemspeed**](https://chemspeed.com/)), and big chemical data ([**MaxPlanck**](https://www.mis.mpg.de/));
2. Pioneered [**AI agents**](https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-024-00832-8) for chemistry and [**retrosynthesis**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.08537) (at EPFL);
3. Invented [**new chemistry**](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/anie.202211168);

Now we want to integrate it into a seamless platform, where anyone who wants to run experiments gets extra **brainpower** and an **additional pair of hands**.

# 🙏 Our Ask:

Do you know anyone in chemistry working in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry?

We would love a warm intro!

Send us an email at:

[founders@b12-labs.com](mailto:founders@b12-labs.com) or send them to our website: [b12-labs.com](http://b12-labs.com)

launches.title: Whispering: Local-First, Open-Source Speech to Text at Your Fingertips
launches.tagline: Own your data. Use any model you want. Free and open source.❤️
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋 It's Braden, and I'm excited to introduce Whispering—a fully open-source, local-first speech-to-text app, and the first app in the Epicenter ecosystem. You can [give it a star](http://go.epicenter.so/github), install it [here](https://go.epicenter.so/install/whispering), and start using it today.

I use Whispering multiple hours daily for voice coding, writing, and thinking out loud. I churned from Wispr Flow and Superwhisper after I built it.

I think the ergonomics are quite delightful, and I hope you will too!

[Voice coding workflow](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tpix588SeiQ)

## **The Problem**

You use a transcription app, but you have no idea what happens to your data.

They’re not open-source. They might call themselves “local” or say “inference stays on device”—but you still can’t see the code. It’s a black box, and for all you know, _you’re the product_.

Your voice recordings might be sitting on their servers and sold to other providers. You're locked into their ecosystem. When they pivot, get acquired, or shut down, your workflow will break.

Many “AI transcription” startups are just API or local inference wrappers with subscription pricing. You speak into their app, they send your audio to a transcription API like Whisper, then charge you monthly for what you could run yourself. Some run locally, but none I found were open-source with the UX I needed.

## **The Solution**

Truly free and open-source transcription software that matches (or surpasses) the ergonomics of paid, closed-software alternatives. I think Whispering is now at that stage.

## **What makes us different:**

There are many other applications in the transcription landscape. Whispering offers some notable features:

* **Hands-free, voice-activated dictation**: One of our most ergonomic features so far. Press once to start the session, and it will automatically start and stop as you speak. No button-holding or toggling nonsense. Perfect for dictating when your hands are full
* **Custom AI transformations with any prompt, any model:** Design custom transformations that chain multiple AI models to fix grammar, translate, or refactor your transcribed text
* **Unbeatable price:**  Nothing beats free. If you bring an API key from [Groq Cloud](https://console.groq.com/keys), you’ll get nearly instantaneous transcription at $0.04/hour plus a generous free tier. And of course, if you run locally with Speeches, it’s completely free. We hope to expand our models soon.
* **Open-source**: MIT licensed. Fork it, examine it, roast it. We pride ourselves in our code quality.
* **Everything is local-first**: In Whispering, everything is local-first. Recordings are stored in IndexedDB, and settings are stored in local storage. Built with Svelte 5 and Tauri, and it's tiny (\~22MB) and fast.

## **Real Daily Usage**

* **Talking to Claude in my room** (3-4 hrs/day): I use dictation to prompt Claude Code significantly faster than typing. I have a custom post-processing transformation set up so that every text blob that I dictate is passed through a Gemini 2.5 Flash prompt, making the output more Claude-Code-friendly (bullet points, etc.). Once done, I paste into Claude Code.
* **While carrying pizza boxes back from the Y Combinator office:** My hands are full, so I’ll open the web app on my phone, turn on voice activated dictation, and then start yapping as thoughts come up. The words are waiting when I get back in my room
* **Other custom transformations**: I have a common writing workflow of speech → Transcribe (Groq) → Fix Grammar (Claude 4 Sonnet) → Format (Gemini 2.5 Flash).

## **Why This Matters**

Fundamental tools shouldn’t require trusting a black box. And they shouldn’t charge you rent for something you could run yourself.

We believe productivity apps should be open-source and transparent with your data, and we want to destroy their business models with open-source alternatives.

These alternatives will need to match them feature-by-feature, have a great UX, and eventually, be built on top of our shared memory layer.

## **Where This Is Going**

Whispering is the first app in the Epicenter ecosystem: local-first, open-source tools built on top of a shared memory of plain text and SQLite. We hope to replace siloed, data-driven tools with local-first alternatives that share a single, user-owned memory layer.

We also hope to support many more offline models over time, giving you maximum flexibility in how and where your data is processed.

We’re not stopping at transcription. While most transcription apps tinker with static dictionaries or custom word lists, our eventual goal with Epicenter is to leverage that shared memory. We could connect transcription to everything you think, write, and build, all within a trustworthy, local-first environment.

Whispering would pick up your common phrases, technical terms, and more. Over time, you create custom transformation pipelines that adapt to your writing style, your voice, and your world.

## **Our Ask**

* 🌟 [**Upvote on Product Hunt**](https://www.producthunt.com/products/whispering?launch=whispering). Help others discover open-source alternatives
* 💻[ **Download the desktop app**](https://go.epicenter.so/install-whispering) from our [installation guide](https://go.epicenter.so/install/whispering), or directly from our latest [releases](https://github.com/epicenter-so/epicenter/releases)
* ⭐ [**Star on GitHub**](https://github.com/epicenter-so/epicenter/tree/main/apps/whispering). Back local-first software. Fork it, break it, improve it. Everything’s MIT licensed. Copy whatever you want.
* 💬 [**Join our Discord**](https://go.epicenter.so/discord). Shape what we build next

Try it, and let us know what’s up. I hope Whispering becomes a part of your workflow!

[Full Setup Guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1jYgBMrfVZs)

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** if you're a hacker, a generalist, a cracked Svelte/Typescript developer, or a local-first/open-source/privacy enthusiast, join our [Discord and DM me](https://go.epicenter.so/discord). I would love to build with you.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nZNOH5yKxO0

Hey everyone! 👋 It’s[ Braden](https://www.linkedin.com/in/braden-wong/), and I’m building Epicenter.

Epicenter is an open-source suite of tools built around a single idea:

**Creativity thrives when you blur the lines between disciplines.**

Your tools should reflect that. Most tools divide you—one for writing, one for planning, one for research. We’re building tools that talk to each other—so you can stay in flow across every kind of work. 

Epicenter will be a growing software ecosystem—a text editor, a CRM, a personal assistant, and more—all built around a shared local memory.

**The problem**

Modern knowledge work is fragmented.

I journal into an app I don’t trust. I plan my week in a calendar app I’ll abandon next month. My notes drift aimlessly in systems I’ve outgrown. And every time I switch apps, the app forgets what I was working on.

Notes, code, and ideas live in isolated tools that don’t talk to each other, breaking flow and burying context.

**The solution**

A suite of open-source tools that share a single memory: a folder on your machine. Open-source, open-format, and fully yours.

The tools share so you can make connections across disciplines. Your ideas and data are never locked in.

[**epicenter.sh**](http://epicenter.sh)

I just launched [epicenter.sh](http://epicenter.sh): a local-first assistant you can chat with. It lives in a folder, and we want to make it the access point to everything you’ve ever written, thought, or built.

[epicenter.sh](http://epicenter.sh) is the first addition to Epicenter. This is your new shell: your second brain becomes your dialogue partner. You type; it thinks. You ask; it searches. Under the hood, it’s powered by a modified version of [Opencode](https://github.com/sst/opencode), an excellent open-source coding agent. We’ve made our own CLI and UI to simplify configuration and the user experience. It’s rough around the edges, but it’s our first step in laying the foundation for our future applications.

**Where We’re Headed**

In a world where every app wants to trap you and your data, we’re building the opposite.

Epicenter is open-source, local-first, and plain-text native—so you can trust it, tweak it, or take it with you. We’re building tools that support intentional, interdisciplinary thinking: software for people who read, write, build, and connect.

A renaissance workflow, built on plain text and real ownership.

**Our Ask**

We’re early. But if you think like a generalist, build like a hacker, and value tools that respect your mind—we’d love to hear from you.

**→ if you’re a cracked Svelte/Typescript developer, please[ DM me](https://go.epicenter.so/discord)**

**→ star / fork / dive into the code on GitHub: [https://github.com/epicenter-md/epicenter/](https://github.com/epicenter-md/epicenter/)**

**→ join the community on [Discord](https://go.epicenter.so/discord). share what you’re excited to build**

Sign up and tell us which tools you’d be most excited to use. Your input will shape what we build next.

**About me:**

At 18, I taught myself to code while studying ethics, politics, and economics at Yale. Since then, I’ve averaged \~10k commits/year and worked at three YC startups. I wrote my 65-page senior thesis on open-source governance and digital platforms. I care deeply about data ownership, open-source, and interdisciplinary thinking.

launches.body:
Hi! We’re [George](https://www.linkedin.com/in/george-lawrence-aab0011a6/) and [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexanderschiff/), and we’re building [Channel3](https://trychannel3.com): **a database of every product on the internet.**

Launch Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gut-0iopIDg&feature=youtu.be

**What?**

Every time you shop on Google, Amazon, or ChatGPT, you’re querying a product database. These companies have built massive product catalogs — with pricing, availability, images, and specs — but they keep this data private. That means only the giants can build shopping experiences. Channel3 is changing that. We’re building a universal product catalog and giving every developer access.

**Got it. What can I use a product database for?**

Any website, app, or AI agent can boost revenue by adding commerce – without holding inventory or processing payments. You could, for example, build a kitchen co-pilot that suggests the best tools for every cook, or a fitness app that intelligently recommends equipment needed for the next class.

**How do I make money with Channel3?**

Monetization is built in. With Channel3, developers earn commission on every sale they drive — no chasing affiliate deals, no ads that break trust, and no subscription fees users won't pay.

**Why now?**

Multimodal models have only just become accurate and cheap enough to recognize products visually and semantically, letting us match duplicates across merchants, structure heaps of messy data, and link variants like color or size.

As AI models get smarter and cheaper, our flywheel accelerates: our catalog will improve, and it will be even easier for developers and vibe-coders to build on our infrastructure.

**Why we’re building this**

Alex discovered this problem firsthand while building an AI teacher that could recommend appropriate products for its students. He discovered that giving AI agents shopping capabilities is both a real pain-point and a growing opportunity, so he persuaded George, his smartest friend from Duke and former co-founder, to leave Palantir and build the solution together.

**I’m in! What now?**

We’re looking for developers who want to build the next generation of shopping on top of Channel3 (and get paid to do it!).

Sign up today at [trychannel3.com](http://trychannel3.com), or reach out at [founders@trychannel3.com](mailto:founders@trychannel3.com).

👋 Hello!

We’re Jiehua and Almo, co-founders of **Comena**. We've been building things together since middle school and this time, we’re automating one of the most painful processes in B2B supply chains.

---

### 🧠 TL;DR

\*\*Comena automates order entry from inbox to ERP for distributors and manufacturers.\*\*\
No more manual data entry. No more wasted time. Our AI reads purchase orders from emails or PDFs, extracts key info, matches products to SKUs, and sends the order to your ERP — with (or even without) human-in-the-loop review.\
**Sales teams save 75-99% of time spent on order processing.**

---

### 😩 The Problem

In industrial supply chains (fasteners, parts, MRO, etc.), every order and inquiry is still typed manually into an ERP.

Here’s how it looks today:

1. A distributor or manufacturer receives a PO via email
2. A sales rep opens a PDF attachment
3. They manually type the content of the e-mail/PDF into the ERP
4. Then it goes to fulfillment

This process is repeated **every single day** and eats up to **50% of inside sales teams’ time** — time that could be spent on proactive selling and customer relationships.

---

### ⚙️ Our Solution

https://youtu.be/yoii7pgK1GY

We built an AI-powered order processing agent that automates this end-to-end:

✅ Forward any PO or RFQ to Comena\
✅ Our AI extracts header data, product descriptions, quantities, pricing, etc.\
✅ Matches the items to your product number (even from messy free-text)\
✅ Sales rep quickly reviews the output\
✅ Sends it to the ERP with 1 click

We support PDFs, Excel sheets, RFQs, email bodies — and integrate seamlessly with ERPs. If your ERP supports EDI, even better: Comena plugs right in.

---

---

### 👬 About Us

We’ve been friends for over 10 years — building robots together and winning awards at robotics world championships when we were younger.

* **Jiehua (CEO)** was the youngest software engineer at Google Switzerland, a PM at Pina Earth (YC W22), and first hire at procurement startup askLio (YC S23).

If you know anyone who fits the below, we’d **love an intro**:\
• Distributors or manufacturers processing lots of POs\

**TL;DR**

We are Lovable, but better because the backends we generate actually work and are easy to debug and evolve.

https://youtu.be/bjpR5A-Ib6k

## Who We Are

We're Alessia and Elia, Computer Science and Data Science graduates from Stanford and ETH Zürich. We've spent years as full-stack engineers building no-code tools that empower non-technical users to create complex systems. Now we're using that experience to help anyone become a full-stack developer through AI.

## The Problem

Prompt-to-app tools like Lovable are incredible at generating beautiful frontends, but they completely fall apart when you need real business logic, integrations, or debugging capabilities.

Here's what every developer using these tools faces:

* **Black box backends:** you can't see or understand what the AI actually built for your server-side logic
* **Debugging nightmare:** when something breaks, you're stuck re-prompting the LLM and hoping it magically fixes the issue
* **Integration hell:** you're forced to manually stitch together Lovable + n8n + Supabase + other tools, creating fragile workflows that break easily and are painful to maintain

This affects thousands of developers who want to build real applications but get stuck when they move beyond simple prototypes.

## Our Solution

VibeFlow transforms prompts into full-stack applications where every single component, frontend AND backend, is visible, understandable, and editable.

### How it works:

* **Visual Backend Editor:** See and edit your app's backend logic like you'd design a UI in Figma. You can edit visually or continue using prompts.
* **Transparent AI Generation:** Unlike other tools, you can see and understand what the AI built, making debugging straightforward
* **Powerful Integrations:** Built-in database and prewired service connections, no external tools required.
* **All-in-One Platform:** Build, debug, deploy, and maintain everything in one cohesive environment

## How We Got Here

We saw builders doing hacky workarounds, connecting n8n and Supabase to power Lovable frontends, creating Frankenstein apps where they didn't even own half the pieces. People were desperate for backend control but stuck with fragmented solutions.

launches.title: Mohi: Debugging assistant for AI agents
launches.tagline: Don’t know why your agent messed up? Neither do we. But Mohi will show you exactly where your agents went wrong - and why.
launches.body:
Hey folks! 👋

We’re building Mohi, a debugging assistant for AI agents. If you've ever spent hours scrolling through 500+ LLM calls asking “what the hell happened?” — this is for you.

https://youtu.be/UzQZlUdZ59s

### The Problem

Agents are complicated — tools, memory, web search, nested loops, and hallucinations. And when something breaks, it’s like untangling spaghetti. You’re stuck scrolling through flat logs, guessing which of the _35_ steps silently failed.

It's slow, brittle, and makes you second-guess your whole stack.

### **The Fix**

Mohi makes debugging agents **_fast_**, and **_actually usable_**.

Just tag key steps in your agent with our lightweight SDK (think: tool calls, memory access, context switches, decision logics), and we build a clean visual graph of what happened under the hood. Then we go a step further and show you:

* where your agent last succeeded
* where it went off the rails (hallucinated, failed tool, wrong branch)
* and how to re-run broken steps with new inputs

It’s not just observability. It's a diagnosis.

### **Who We Are**

Previously, Hao worked on AI and distributed systems observability at AWS, and Evan worked on automated testing at Google and AI evaluations at SecureBio. We met at MIT and worked on a bunch of projects together, eventually building agents ourselves and seeing firsthand how painful debugging can be — so we built Mohi to fix it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92831&key=user_uploads/1675765/aa1f6344-8ce0-4ad5-a5ba-0e203412791a)

If you’re building complex agents — we’d love to chat!

launches.tagline: Harvey for insurance - AI that automates insurance claims and stops wrongful payouts
launches.body:
**TLDR:** We are building Harvey for insurance. We help insurers automate claims and stop wrongful payouts using verifiable AI agents.

Our team has spent the last decade battling legacy systems and dogma across highly regulated sectors of the financial industry. We’ve founded an EU-licensed bank (under the EBA CRD) and been part of scaling Europe’s fastest-growing InsurTech. We’ve seen firsthand the challenges with manual claims handling and how AI can fundamentally transform this process

[**https://youtu.be/wfX4D08cNk4**](https://youtu.be/wfX4D08cNk4)

---

**The problem**

Yearly insurance claim payouts total more than $6.5 trillion (6% of worldwide GDP). The way insurance is sold has evolved considerably, but the handling of claims has remained largely unchanged since the early days of the internet. Due to the inconsistent nature of manual processing, handling errors alone are estimated to cause more than $200B in wrongful payouts per year. Add another $75B to that number for administrative operating expenses, and a rough idea of the true cost emerges.

The industry’s fix to this problem? Windows 2000-era admin UIs glued onto IBM mainframe systems, fragile RPA-automations that break every Feb 29th, and an army of adjusters. The result is a mess of growing complexity - and customers pay the price.

---

**The solution**

Solva automates repetitive tasks and prevents wrongful payouts using verifiable, self-learning AI agents - built to run seamlessly on top of any existing claims stack.

Solva’s system:

* Detects incomplete evidence
* Identifies breaches of policy terms
* Exposes fraudulent behavior
* Delivers source-cited claim recommendations

We bring claims handling from punchcards to Claude Code - helping insurers to stop spending billions on repetitive tasks and wrongful payouts.

---

**The team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92740&key=user_uploads/2404520/068071e0-ad95-4555-bc06-332e3c2e2fbd)

Hey everyone [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand) Happy 4th of July!

We’re [Jason](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jason-k-cornelius/) from NASA and [Steve](https://www.linkedin.com/in/steve-messinger-a32680155/) from Boeing – and now, we’re co-founders of [Perseus Defense](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/perseus-defense).

# **TL;DR — We're building guided micro-missiles that shoot down drones in combat**

**_Ask_:** Do you know end-users across the Department of Defense (DoD) and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) that could benefit from attritable anti-drone solutions?

https://youtu.be/o17lMdLuZWQ

# **❌ The Problem**

Today’s Counter-Unmanned Aerial System (**CUAS**) solutions are too expensive, too heavy, too slow, and too ineffective.

1. **70-80%** of battlefield fatalities come from drone strikes
2. **$100,000+** kinetic solutions are used to counteract **$500** drones
   * **$500** drones are eliminating **$100M** assets
3. Current solutions are easily defeated with fiber-optic, visual inertial odometry, or simple waypoint navigation missions

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91870&key=user_uploads/1658535/5caa36d2-7e58-4001-b716-33dadb3e92b5)

_$500 Ukrainian drones decimate $100M Russian strategic bombers_

Perseus is creating the first affordable guided micro-missile pods to bolster American defense capabilities both at home and abroad.

Our micro-guided missiles detect, identify, and eliminate incoming threats before they can reach their intended target. They cost less than $10k, which is 2 orders of magnitude less than the current best solutions.

Steve and I felt we could create a better solution to the CUAS problem and decided we had a moral obligation to follow through on that belief. We quit our old jobs and put it all on the line to fast-track this capability for the U.S. and our allies.

launches.title: Novaflow – The AI data analyst for biology labs
launches.tagline: Accelerating scientific progress
launches.body:
We’re Aman and Amulya, and we’re building Novaflow. 

**TL;DR —** Bioinformatics data analysis is a time-consuming and expensive process for scientists. With Novaflow, life scientists can upload experimental data, ask questions in plain English, and get instant, publication-ready plots, giving them results in minutes instead of months. 

[Intro Video](https://youtu.be/uwi8N9rjCUI)

### **Our Story**

Aman was a computational biologist and saw firsthand how his colleagues struggled to analyze their experimental results quickly due to a growing backlog of data in the lab. Despite spending over $100,000 a year on data analysis, it still wasn’t enough. He realized that using LLMs, this process can be automated away and save researchers time and money. He teamed up with his friend Amulya who was a software engineer at Zoom to bring this product to life. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92462&key=user_uploads/244146/e5819898-8cdb-480f-9c21-31590b2c7232)


### **The problem**

Life science labs generate huge datasets, but analysis is slow, expensive, and talent‑constrained:

* **Expensive.** Small labs routinely spend **$100k+/year per analyst**; large labs spend millions. 
* **Talent bottleneck.** Many groups run **\~5:1 experimentalists to analysts**, so researchers wait weeks to months for results.
* **Dual expertise required.** Useful analysis needs **both** strong coding skills and deep biological context—most researchers only have one.
* **Resource‑intensive + fragmented tooling.** Labs often lack scalable compute, standardization, or long‑term data management. Many are stuck with custom scripts and tools that feel **15+ years behind**.

### **Our Solution**

We want to put analysis **back in the hands of researchers**:

* 🧠 **LLM‑powered pipelines** that plan, generate, and run bioinformatics workflows behind the scenes
* 📊 **Instant, publication‑ready plots** from raw CSVs, FASTQs, BAMs., and more
* 🔍 **Natural‑language querying** (“Which genes are most differentially expressed?”)
* 🧪 **Exportable Jupyter notebooks & reproducible Python code** for auditability and downstream tweaking
* ♻️ **Versioned runs & provenance** so you can rerun, compare, and share analyses confidently

### **How it works**

1. **Upload your data + describe the experiment** (e.g., “scRNA‑seq of treated vs. control organoids”).
2. **Novaflow infers the right workflow** (e.g., QC, normalization, clustering/UMAP for scRNA‑seq; DE for bulk RNA‑seq; peak calling + motif analysis for ATAC‑seq).
3. **We spin up the compute, run the pipeline, and return plots**, summaries, and a notebook you can keep, rerun, or extend.

### **Who this is for**

* **Life scientists** blocked by slow or missing bioinformatics support
* **Academic labs** doing genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, etc.
* **Biotech teams** that want to accelerate R&D with leaner headcount

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're the team behind [**mcp-use**](https://github.com/mcp-use/mcp-use), the open-source MCP framework with **10k GitHub stars** and **\~10M+ downloads**.

[**Manufact**](https://manufact.com/) is the cloud platform that gets your product onto the **Claude Connectors marketplace** and the **ChatGPT (Codex) Plugin Store** via MCP.

<https://youtu.be/Pyh_3tKDXuU>

## The problem

Paul Graham recently tweeted: "_AI apps are the new browsers_". \
Your customers now do most of their work inside Claude and ChatGPT, and the connector marketplaces are a new distribution channel: someone installs your product in one click and uses it inside the chat they already live in.

We listed Manufact on Claude and saw a **surge of signups** that is still going on now.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/65a0b3fd-75cf-4eea-a2ee-02590e3256ba)

But shipping a production-ready MCP server is its own project:

* MCP is a protocol evolving fast .
* Auth is easy to get [wrong](https://manufact.com/blog/authentication).
* Every client behaves differently.
* The stores have their own conformance requirements, and review can block you for weeks.

## How Manufact works

Manufact is the cloud built specifically for MCP:

* **Push to deploy.** Connect the GitHub App once and [every commit ships a new version of your MCP server](https://manufact.com/platform/hosting), with a preview deployment for each PR.
* **Test every MCP tool and MCP-UI widget** in the [cloud inspector](https://manufact.com/platform/cloud-inspector).
* **Know the moment your MCP breaks** in ChatGPT or Claude with [automatic cross-client testing](https://manufact.com/platform/cross-client-testing).
* [**Publishing checklists**](https://manufact.com/platform/publishing-checks) so your MCP app doesn't get stuck in marketplace review.
* **Auto-generated submission assets** (logo, copy, screenshots).
* **Analytics, session replay, and traces** built in for MCP, so you can see [how it's used and why tools fail](https://manufact.com/platform/analytics).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/ee30e016-9fb5-4958-890f-74febc54de3c)

## Your product's UI inside the chat

A plain MCP server lets the agent read and write your data. \
An **MCP App** goes further: it's an MCP server that can return a UI as the result of a tool call, so your actual product interface renders inside Claude or ChatGPT. The user sees your charts and forms instead of a wall of text.

Ferruccio Balestreri (Amplitude) [put it well](https://x.com/0xferruccio/status/2028966278971670979):

> since mcp ui was released in claude we got a 2x boost in retention.

With the [mcp-use SDK](https://github.com/mcp-use/mcp-use) you write a normal React component, drop it in, and it registers as an MCP UI resource automatically.

## Backstory

We've been building on MCP since the protocol shipped. It started with the mcp-use SDK, the full-stack framework for MCP servers and apps. We kept watching companies struggle to take those servers to production, so we built the cloud for it (mcp-use is to Manufact what Next.js is to Vercel).

Manufact is now the **#1 recommended deployment option in OpenAI's docs.** 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/ddba2350-67c4-43d5-8150-30847d4375a2)

We've helped startups from recent YC batches like **AgentMail** and **Item** get onto the Claude Connectors marketplace, and larger companies in finance, insurance, and marketplaces run their MCP apps on Manufact in production.

## Our asks

1. Have an MCP server? **Deploy it on [Manufact](https://manufact.com/)**.
2. Thinking about building an MCP App? [Copy our prompt for agents](https://manufact.com/prompt.md) and your coding agent will guide you.
3. Trying to get listed on the marketplaces? [Book a call with us](https://cal.com/team/manufact/chat). We have publishing checks and direct contacts on the MCP teams at Anthropic and OpenAI.

Hope to see your MCP on [manufact.com](http://manufact.com), or that you at least learned something new. 🙂

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/685643a6-ecd5-42b4-b55f-ec394967ca57)
