### **TL;DR**

[Manufact](https://manufact.com) is the MCP cloud for dev teams to ship MCP Apps and Servers in production. Connect a GitHub repo and Manufact handles deployment, security, observability, and scaling, so teams can ship in minutes instead of weeks.

One codebase, deployed everywhere users and agents already live: the ChatGPT Apps Store, Claude Connectors, Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code, and more.

We're also the creators of [mcp-use SDK](https://github.com/mcp-use/mcp-use), the most popular high-level MCP framework for building MCP Apps and Servers.\
(mcp-use SDK is to the Model Context Protocol SDKs what Next.js is to React!)

It’s open-source and used by developers at 20% of US500 and companies like 6sense, Elastic, IBM, Innovacer, Intuit, NVIDIA, Oracle, Red Hat, Tavily, and Verizon are building with us.

### **The ask**

If you're building MCP Apps or Servers, or you know someone who is, we'd love to talk.

<https://cal.com/team/manufact/chat> \
or shoot a message to us: +1 (628) 899-2498 \
or [founders@manufact.com](mailto:founders@manufact.com)

### **Our story**

When MCP came out, we couldn't believe such a powerful protocol was locked into IDEs and Claude Desktop.

So we built mcp-use, the open source framework that lets any developer build MCP Apps and Servers in code, in a structured and composable way.

It got adopted fast: 7M+ downloads across Python and TypeScript, almost 10k GitHub stars, and dev teams at top companies shipping with it.

But OSS is only half the story. Once teams had something working, they hit the wall every infra team knows: deployment, auth, secrets, observability, scaling. Stitching that together for MCP is a multi-week project. That's what Manufact solves.

### **Make something agents want**

MCP unlocks something most products have never had access to before: real estate inside ChatGPT and Claude.

800M+ users already spend their day in those chats. \
With MCP, a product can show up there as a native app or connector, with no separate UI to build, no app to install, no new login flow. \
The user just asks, and your product does the work.

### **Problem**

The catch is that "build once, ship everywhere" is its own infra problem. ChatGPT Apps, Claude Connectors, Gemini, and the long tail of agent surfaces (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenAI Agents, Mastra, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) each have their own quirks, auth flows, and submission requirements. Manufact lets you build one codebase and ship it to all of them.

### **What Manufact does**

Connect your MCP repo once. Every push auto-deploys.

1. **Build:** Scaffold a full MCP App or Server with _npx create-mcp-use-app_ or drop in existing MCP code unchanged.
2. **Deploy:** GitHub App connects once. Every push auto-deploys to Manufact Cloud. Preview URL per branch. Custom domains with SSL handled.
3. **Publish.** Get your app in front of users in the ChatGPT Apps Store and Claude Connectors. Submission assets, marketplace checklists, and an embeddable chat widget for your own site, docs, or campaign pages.
4. **Iterate.** Cloud Inspector debugs from any browser against real clients. Swap models. Run evals on every deploy.
5. **Monitor.** Analytics, session replay, JSON-RPC traces, and alerts on regressions, so you catch issues before users do. Less than 60 seconds from _git push_ to a live MCP App or Server, available across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and any agent surface that speaks MCP.

Do you know anyone already using MCP servers internally or building products powered by AI agents?

For the first few companies we will personally create/integrate MCP servers you need, have everything running through our platform, either on cloud or your own infrastructure. We even help you integrate our SDK into your code.

What do you think? Can we help you?

Motives is a team of AI agents that runs qualitative research for consumer brands. Running a focus group can cost $20k+ and take 1-2 months to recruit participants, interview them, and analyze the results - Motives AI runs that whole process in 1-2 days.

**The problem**

Marketing teams thrive on understanding their customers, with large brands spending $100mn/year on consumer research. Today they choose between surveys, which are fast and affordable but shallow, and focus groups or in-depth interviews, which can cost tens of thousands of dollars and take weeks or months.

**The solution**

We’ve built AI agents that can plan, run, and analyze consumer interviews, giving marketing teams deep qualitative insights in days instead of months.

https://youtu.be/dHFtzfFaRKg

Ask a research question, and get results in hours - here’s how it works:

* Customers chat with our AI agent to describe their research questions or the concepts they need to test, and our AI builds a research plan. 
* Our AI then recruits relevant people from our global panel network and interviews them over video.
* The AI automatically analyzes the interviews and generates a report with actionable insights. 
* Customers can view specific video highlights and chat with our AI to answer follow-up questions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92560&key=user_uploads/1153026/b6befb62-7947-4b2a-bc94-fd9caf7d4946)

Our customers include some of the biggest consumer brands in the US and Europe - check out our [case study](https://www.motives.ai/posts/motives-wild) about how Unilever’s recent acquisition Wild has been using Motives to test new packaging concepts.

**Who we are**

Sean (CEO) ex-PM and Growth at Google, Dataiku, and Truelayer

We’ve been friends since our undergrad days at Oxford. From our own product development backgrounds we know how difficult it is to learn what your customers really want - so we’re building a better way, focusing on helping marketing teams at consumer brands since they feel the pain on the largest scale.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We all combine deep domain expertise in mid-market and enterprise workflow automation. 

Lorenz and Jonas worked together for 4+ years at TradeLink (SCM-SaaS backed by Point Nine, Insight), accompanying the path from 0 to product-market fit. Lorenz led Product; Jonas led Go-to-Market. Both quit their leadership roles to found Finto. 

Knowing each other from the Munich startup scene, Linus joined as Co-Founder & CTO. He was previously an early tech lead at Tacto (Procurement SaaS backed by Sequoia, Index), helping scale it from pre-seed to one of Europe’s largest Series A rounds in mid-market SaaS.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Enterprises with complex vendor supply chains produce vast amounts of incoming vendor invoices each year. A typical **mid-market enterprise processes \~100k incoming invoices** **yearly**, and today, an accountant tops out at \~10-20k invoices per year because the real grind is still manual: 

* Key-stroking invoice data to the ERP
* Manual invoice review and compliance checks
* Manual managing deviations with purchase orders
* Manual allocate ledger accounts and cost center codes
* Chasing approvals. That’s why enterprises still staff large accounting teams - or ship the work to shared-service centers.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
AI will write the final chapter of accounting software. What once required teams, training, and manual effort now happens in real-time - intelligently, autonomously, and at scale through agents. 

Finto is our contribution to this future. As AI agents become capable of understanding context, learning from company-specific data, and executing complex workflows, entire job profiles will shift away from manual execution. With its predictable but intricate schemes, accounting is poised to be one of the first areas transformed. 

Doubling down on our domain expertise, we are on a mission to **take the manual out of accounting**.

launches.body:
**Finto - AI Accounting for Enterprises**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otqOvfepgKQ

**TL;DR**

Finto builds an AI accounting software for enterprise finance teams. We automate the invoice-to-pay process from their email inbox to their ERP including invoice handling, supplier communication, 3-way matching, and ERP data entry.

**Problem**

Enterprises with complex vendor supply chains produce vast amounts of incoming vendor invoices each year. A typical **mid-market enterprise processes \~100k incoming invoices** **yearly**, and today’s legacy tools force accountants to top out at a fraction of the volume: Real manual grunt work still remains:

* Handling hundreds of mails and documents a day
* Key-stroking invoice data to the ERP
* Manual invoices checks and account coding
* Manual managing deviations with purchase orders
* Chasing approvals

That’s why enterprises still staff large accounting teams - or ship the work to shared-service centers. Our mission is to free the world’s finance teams from repetitive, low-value tasks so they can focus on impactful work. That starts with building a place where everyone can do their best work.

**Solution**

We build a platform embedding AI agents to automate the end-to-end invoice-to-pay cycle:

1. **Classify** inbox documents (invoice, receipts, reminder)
2. **Read** invoices at **99%+ accuracy** - even on line item level
3. **Check** on vendor, tax, bank, and compliance data
4. **Email vendors** automatically if something’s off
5. **Understand & code** ledger, cost-center or project numbers
6. **Three-Way-Match** invoice orders with POs and GRs
7. **Collect** **&** **chase** required approvals
8. **Post to ERP**

launches.body:
Coding tools have 10x’d not only dev speed, but also the surface area for bugs. The bottleneck has shifted to validating that features and fixes _actually_ work. 

Your team is probably spending hours doing at least one of these things:

* Manually testing for regressions
* Writing and maintaining brittle E2E test scripts
* Saying “f\*ck it, ship it,” way too often

All while still having users complain about bugs that slip into prod…

“Can’t my coding agent just write my E2E tests for me?”

Sure - but now you’re stuck maintaining them as your app evolves - broken selectors, missing element IDs, new user journeys, non-deterministic environments, evolving infra requirements…

Not to mention the cases that are nearly impossible to test with scripts in the first place: Apple Pay, in-app browser flows, complex swipes, drag-and-drop, magic links, OAuth, cross-app auth, etc…

This is why we built **Autosana** - **the agentic E2E testing layer to close the loop with your coding agents.** Fully vision based, testing your app like humans would. 

* Get onboarded seamlessly via our [MCP](https://docs.autosana.ai/mcp-setup)
* Runs locally and in our cloud for multi-env testing
* Code review + E2E testing in your PR with video proof
* Tests evolving with your codebase, creating & running tests based on PR context and code diffs
* Works across iOS, Android, mobile web, and desktop web

launches.body:
Hey guys!

We’re Uv and Jason from Autosana 🌊

We’re building a QA agent that tests mobile apps like a real user. We’re on a mission to make flaky selector-based test scripts (or worse, manual regression testing) things of the past.

[Demo here :)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zsY22nvcVLU)

# **TL;DR**

* Cloud-hosted mobile QA agent (iOS and Android)
* Natural language → simulated user flows
* Integrates into CI/CD
* Saves 8+ eng. hours per deployment

# **Problem**

**Dev Tools Have Evolved — QA Tools Haven’t**

Tools like Cursor and Claude Code boost dev speed by 10x, but lack the runtime context to write E2E tests, especially for complex and non-deterministic flows.

**The QA Bottleneck**

Maintaining traditional end-to-end scripts using frameworks like Appium, Espresso, and XCUITest wastes valuable engineering resources (trust us, we’ve been there).

These tests are tedious to write, brittle, and routinely break with UI changes. Many mobile teams ($100B+ companies included) have abandoned them and rely on manual QA.

# **Solution**

We started Autosana to fix the QA bottleneck and help mobile teams ship faster without fear of breaking things.

Just describe your test flows with natural language, as if you’re talking to your own **in-house QA Engineer**. No code, no infra setup, no dependence on flaky element selectors, and no more manual work.

Our agent tests your app like a real user, as **part of your CI/CD** pipeline or on a schedule, and **reports to the team when bugs are found**.

Autosana supports both iOS and Android, and is framework-agnostic (we support React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, you name it…).

**Mobile QA shouldn’t be hard. We’re on a mission to fix the bottleneck between mobile development and testing.**

Have a bug-free day (or many bug-free days, with Autosana <3)

## Who We Are

We're Ritam, Jon, Ritvik, and Arjun — four friends who met at the University of Florida. We started Knowlify because we were tired of dense material nobody actually absorbs. Onboarding teams, training managers, marketers, and comms leads kept asking us to turn _their_ documents into video too.

So we followed the pull. Today Knowlify is the AI video company for business.

## The Problem

Every company runs on documents — onboarding guides, SOPs, training manuals, product specs, safety procedures, internal updates. And almost nobody reads them.

* People retain far more from a short video than from a wall of text, yet most company knowledge still lives in PDFs and slide decks.

One platform for the everyday volume, one studio for the flagship pieces. Both turn the content you already have into video people actually watch.

launches.title: Omnara: The API for Production-Ready agents
launches.tagline: Open-source alternative to claude managed agents
launches.body:
Omnara is an open-source platform for creating and interacting with production-ready agents via an API, without having to worry about the tedious parts of managing an agent control plane. It’s an open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents, Langchain Managed Agents, Vercel Eve, etc.

## **Problem:**

---

Building agents is hard. Many companies are building agent control planes, both for internal use and external use. The common pattern is you use some local agent framework, like claude agent sdk, mastra, langchain, or your own loop, host that on VMs/kubernetes/workers, expose an API with endpoints to interact with agents, handle machine failures, resumption of an agent, provisioning sandbox environments so those agents can code, configure endpoints to add skills and MCPs, have user message tracking, audit logs, and on and on.

It’s a lot of infrastructure work that has nothing to do with what the agent actually does. And most teams end up having to build and maintain their own versions of it.

Omnara is that layer. It provides this infrastructure for you. So you can create and interact with your agents through a standard API without having to worry about building and maintaining your own control plane.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112080&key=user_uploads/1391601/7b5a0575-9a32-4af8-966f-9b6370e74edc)

## **Bring your own computer:**

Run this on any linux or macOS machine (windows coming soon): \
**curl -fsSL https://app.omnara.com/install/omnarad.sh | sh**\
It connects the machine to the Omnara control plane. You can then give any agent access to this machine. This allows you to spin up an EC2 instance and have your agents use that as a persistent machine, or even run it on your macbook so that cloud agents can directly edit files locally when it’s online. You can also bring your own sandbox provider API keys (currently we support Blaxel, Daytona, and Unikraft).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112080&key=user_uploads/1391601/55bd57b2-62f9-414e-8acc-405797264d3a)

## **Bring your own model:**

Omnara allows you to bring your own LLM endpoint and API key (we support OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Completions, and Anthropic Messages formats, with more coming soon). You can use your hundreds of thousands of free LLM credits from YC in Omnara!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112080&key=user_uploads/1391601/12802420-8c49-4609-bd5c-9b7df94954f6)

---

Because you can bring your own machine and models, you can use Omnara for completely free! Our architecture allows us to efficiently host hundreds of millions of agents on minimal hardware, so we can easily eat that cost.

If you prefer our hosted models (via openrouter) and hosted sandboxes (via blaxel), we're giving $1,000 in credits to the first 50 teams building on Omnara. Email us at [**contact@omnara.com**](mailto:contact@omnara.com) with what you're building and we’ll apply the credits to your organization.

If you want help self-hosting the control plane or running it in your VPC/on-prem, we’re taking on five design partners. Email [**ishaan@omnara.com**](mailto:ishaan@omnara.com).

Website: [**omnara.com**](http://omnara.com) \
App: [**app.omnara.com**](http://app.omnara.com) \
Docs: [**docs.omnara.com**](http://docs.omnara.com) \
Source: [**github.com/omnara-ai/omnara**](http://github.com/omnara-ai/omnara)

launches.body:
We’re Ishaan and Kartik, and we’re building **Omnara**, a web and mobile interface for Claude Code that lets you keep coding agents moving even when you’re away from your desk.

🎥 Demo:[ https://x.com/i/status/2014383431845839186](https://x.com/i/status/2014383431845839186)

## **❌ The Problem**

Coding agents can work independently for long stretches, but they still block on human input.

If an agent needs clarification while you’re away, everything pauses.\
If your laptop sleeps, long-running work stops.\
Most remote agent tools run in hosted environments instead of where your code actually lives.

Agents should fit around your schedule, not the other way around.

## **🛠️ The Solution**

**Omnara makes working with coding agents feel continuous instead of fragile.**

You can:

* Start agents locally and stay involved from anywhere using web or mobile
* Keep work moving even if your laptop goes offline
* Talk to agents using voice when typing isn’t convenient

## **🔒 Run agents in your environment, access them from anywhere**

With Omnara, your coding agent runs on your own machine, whether that’s your laptop or a remote VM you control.

You can access and interact with that agent from anywhere, securely, without SSH, port forwarding, or tunneling.

Your agent runs in your real environment, but you’re not tied to the machine it’s running on.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97081&key=user_uploads/2661368/81388baf-658a-4c43-94ac-1ce4e17a1605)

## **☁️ Keep agents running when your machine is off**

Agents shouldn’t stop just because your laptop does.

If your machine goes offline, Omnara can keep the agent running in the cloud so work continues. You can still interact from web or mobile, and when you’re back at your desk, you can pick up where things left off.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97081&key=user_uploads/2661368/098a8bf1-046d-4362-86b2-63d984e999dd)

## **🎙️ Talk to your coding agent**

Mobile typing works for quick replies, but it’s not great for longer back and forth.

Omnara includes voice so you can talk to your coding agent when typing isn’t convenient. Speaking tends to provide more context and makes it easier to iterate, especially while walking or multitasking.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97081&key=user_uploads/2661368/829c73b5-6a60-41e8-a9c3-0fa98de80d39)

launches.title: Omnara - The first command center for AI agents: terminal, web, and mobile
launches.tagline: Run Claude Code from anywhere and switch seamlessly between devices
launches.body:
https://www.loom.com/share/03d30efcf8e44035af03cbfebf840c73

Start Claude Code in the terminal, then pick it up instantly on web or mobile with a seamless handoff between all three

### The Problem

Claude Code is incredible, but it chains you to your desk.\
Once an agent starts working, you’re stuck waiting in the terminal for it to ask you something. That could take 5–10 minutes, and if you’re away, progress halts. We’ve coded from our beds, on walks, in Ubers, while doing laundry… and yes, even on the toilet — but only after we built Omnara.

Existing solutions don’t solve this well:

* **Other Claude Code wrappers** (e.g., Crystal, Conductor) often replace the native experience but don’t let you jump between terminal, web, and mobile.
* **Terminal replication tools** (e.g., Vibetunnel, Termius) let you SSH in, but have no push notifications, clean diffs, or simple setup.

### What’s Omnara?

Omnara is the **first agent command center** — start an AI agent in the terminal, then continue the same session from our web dashboard or mobile app.

With Omnara, you can:

* Launch agents from terminal, web, or mobile.
* Switch between them instantly.
* Get **real-time push notifications** when agents need your input.
* Review logs, see Git diffs, and approve/reject changes with one tap.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93029&key=user_uploads/1391601/bf61f9ae-4f37-4377-90c8-fc2bed1d0866)

**How it works**\
We built a CLI wrapper that mirrors the native Claude Code experience — output, permissions, notifications, and mode switching — by parsing the session file at _\~/.claude/projects_ and terminal output in real time. All agent and user messages are streamed via SSE to the Omnara platform, where you can respond from anywhere.

It’s fully open source: [github.com/omnara-ai/omnara](https://github.com/omnara-ai/omnara)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93029&key=user_uploads/1391601/837e9af0-e038-4bb1-9f1c-1ebf152f8157)

### Why launch with Claude Code first?

Omnara works with any AI agent, but Claude Code users immediately “get” the value. It’s the perfect human-in-the-loop use case — and the one we use every day.

We’ve also used Omnara as a human-in-the-loop node in n8n workflows, e.g., for replying to emails. This is just the beginning.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93029&key=user_uploads/1391601/96e585a6-db46-4a20-8901-0ddbc7e409cf)

### Pricing

Free for up to 10 agent sessions/month.\
$9/month for unlimited.

### About Us

We’re **Ishaan & Kartik**, childhood friends since Montessori. We’ve spent years working in AI and AI infra at big tech and acquired startups and love building tools that remove friction for developers.

### Try it free

`pip install omnara && omnara`Then log in at [omnara.com](http://omnara.com) or download our iOS app: [Omnara on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/omnara-ai-command-center/id674...)

launches.body:
Hey YC 👋

We're [**Niek**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/niek-hogenboom/) and [**Titus**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/titus-ex-85691711a/) from [**Minimal AI**](https://gominimal.ai/).

# **TL;DR**

Minimal AI makes it easy for e-commerce brands to build and manage AI support teams that resolve 90% of tickets at human-level quality. The result: reduced support costs while actually improving customer experience and sales. Minimal AI’s Agents currently resolve tens of thousands of tickets per day.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zi9eLe0-z_Q>

# **Problem**

Everyone thinks AI customer support is solved. It's not. E-commerce customer support is complex and fast-paced. Stores have:

1. Fragmented tech stacks (e.g. Shopify + Zendesk + Shipbob + 12 other tools)
2. Policies that change weekly (return windows, shipping rates, product launches etc.)
3. Brand-specific nuances (tone-of-voice, upsell strategies etc.)

Current solutions force an impossible choice: spend months on expensive implementations with endless vendor calls and complex solutions (that break whenever your business evolves), or settle for basic black-box chatbots that frustrate customers. E-commerce brands can't afford to waste resources on either. Tom Blomfield even called current AI Customer Service tools vaporware:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92995&key=user_uploads/1977649/0d7deb74-50db-4652-997e-95150298f702)

# **Solution**

We make it easy for e-commerce brands to build and manage AI customer support teams that resolve 80% of tickets.

**How it works**\
Users train and manage the AI Agents through a single conversational\
interface called the AI Manager. Users can transparently see the Agent's reasoning, provide feedback, and watch it instantly update protocols. The AI Manager also spots gaps and proactively suggests improvements.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92995&key=user_uploads/1977649/de1a17d0-bca1-4a28-88e2-4aabc24ad8b7)

For example, users might say:

* _"For ticket #12345, use the WMS tracking URL instead of Shopify next time"_
* _"Orders from multiple ShipBob locations arrive separately - warn customers upfront"_
* _"Damaged items need 2 clear photos before refunding"_

The AI Manager instantly updates protocols and asks clarifying questions when needed. Done. Your Agents now handle similar cases perfectly.

It feels like outsourcing your support to a team of AI Agents, with the AI Manager as single point of contact.

# **Team**

Niek and Titus have known each other for two years and met through mutual friends.

[**Niek**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/niek-hogenboom/) (CEO) - Niek started his first business at the age of 16, selling and importing custom suits from his parents' house and sold the business 3 years later. After graduating from Aerospace Engineering at Delft University of Technology, he spent a year leading the most successful solar racing team in the world and grew his startup SitRight to $2M+ revenue during covid. name: Floot
long_description:
Floot is the layer where vibecoded software runs.

SaaS is dead. Hundreds of millions of people already spend their day in Claude or ChatGPT - and increasingly, when they need an app, they won't buy one. They'll describe it, and it will exist.

We're building the infrastructure that makes that real. When Claude creates an app, it needs somewhere for that app to live: a backend, a database, hosting, a domain, the ability to scale, various services, maybe even to be able to work as a mobile app. Floot is that place - a full stack purpose-built for AI to operate, from a specialized framework that defines how AI writes and runs code, down to scalable hosting on AWS.

This means you can now build and ship real apps directly inside Claude and ChatGPT. Connect Floot, and the model you already pay for writes and debugs the code, shows a live preview, and publishes to your own domain. No need to wire up git, vercel, supabase and a dozen other providers. And no AI credits - every message runs on the subscription you already have, because we charge for the platform, not for a token markup.

We built Floot this way because we've watched the model layer commoditize - every serious builder writes good code now, including us. The lasting value isn't another agent between you and the model. It's the layer underneath, from wherever people already are. We're building Floot to be the home for all operation software, for the decades where most new software on earth is written by AI.

✨ Try it: floot.com

launches.title: Floot - The easiest and most powerful AI app builder
launches.tagline: The fastest way for non-coders & entrepreneurs to build apps that actually work.
launches.body:
Hi everyone 👋 We’re Edward and Yujian, the founders of Floot!

**TLDR:** Floot lets non-coders & entrepreneurs build real web apps that actually work. We’re taking a new approach by building everything from the ground up for AI.

✨ [Try building an app right now!](https://floot.com)

# The Problem

Existing AI app builders fall short of enabling non-coders to build real, serious apps. They often:

* **Break down** when building anything more than a prototype or toy app
* **Have non-coders stuck** with errors they don’t understand
* **Require non-coders to handle multiple services** designed for developers (e.g. for backend, database, hosting, etc)

**The fundamental problem**: these AI app builders just cobble together existing developer tools and slap AI on top, but these tools were designed for humans and not for AI.

The result? Non-coders get excited, start building, hit a wall, and then abandon their projects.

# Our Solution

Floot is purpose-built for AI. Our secret sauce:

1. Instead of reusing a coding framework designed for humans, **we created a specialized framework** that dictates how AI should write code and how the code runs on our infrastructure. This allows us to enforce best practices, detect errors earlier, and give the best feedback to the AI. As a result, Floot can write better code and fix issues more effectively.
2. **Floot has the entire tech stack built-in** (backend, database, hosting, etc) so building and managing an app feels seamless, especially for non-coders. And because we control every layer of the stack, we can optimize each layer for AI-first coding.

Because of this, **non-coders can get more done with less time** and prompting. They can finally **build serious apps** that work, instead of getting stuck in frustrating error loops and then abandoning their projects.

We also built a **highly scalable hosting system** directly on AWS so Floot apps can handle real traffic and business demands. This means non-coders can build, deploy, and scale their apps on a single platform seamlessly.

Plus, **Floot is really fun to use**! It takes your prompt, breaks it down, and shows you how it accomplishes each step. If it sees a bug while building, it lets you know and fixes it right away.

You can even draw on your app to visually communicate the changes you want:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92516&key=user_uploads/2071169/b6bd69f7-9f86-4db9-929e-4ad3ab66b129)

**Here’s what a customer said about Floot:**

_I'd tried other platforms but could never advance far enough to feel truly productive. The time investment and constant token usage just to fix issues had me ready to hire a developer again. With Floot, I had a working app within a week, even working in my off-hours, and started beta testing with my team days later. We estimate Floot has saved us around $20,000 so far. Best of all, their customer support has gone above and beyond at every turn._

✨ [Try Floot yourself!](https://floot.com) (bonus: build something you’ve made in other tools to compare)

# Why are we building this?

We believe that existing tools are based on technologies built for human developers and ill-suited for the future of AI writing most of the code. The whole toolchain of building and maintaining software desperately needs to adapt to the new reality. We are starting with web apps with the goal of evolving into the new foundation of software, empowering the next generation of builders.

# Team

[Yujian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yjyao/) was a staff software engineer at Retool and Asana. At Retool, he rebuilt the entire runtime to optimize the user experience for builders. At Asana, he built the rich editor that powers every task and comment. Yujian ranked 4th in the National Olympiad in Informatics, Singapore.

[Edward](https://www.linkedin.com/in/edwlk/) scaled his SaaS to 10k+ customers by taking something technically complex and making it accessible to non-technical users, and now he’s doing the same with Floot. For his SaaS, he built a highly scalable and reliable distributed system to handle low-latency applications. Before that, Edward built infrastructure at AWS and studied CS at Berkeley.

# Our ask

✨ [Try building an app in minutes on Floot!](https://floot.com)

We’d love your feedback (even nitpicks!) - reach us at [founders@floot.com](mailto:founders@floot.com)

Know someone who needs to build an app? Have them try Floot :)

launches.body:
We’re [Will](https://www.linkedin.com/in/w-weber/) and [Todd](https://www.linkedin.com/in/todsul/) 👋 and we’re building the first customer support outsourcing option for travel and transport companies that doesn’t rely on humans. Instead of massive offshore teams, Humoniq runs on AI agents delivering faster, cheaper, more helpful service.

We previously built [Flightfox (YC S12)](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/flightfox) where we grew revenue to over $22M annually, and ran support operations handling millions of customer interactions. That experience showed us how easily traditional outsourcing breaks under the pressure of travel’s unique demands, and gave us the conviction that AI is the only way to build something better.

[**https://youtu.be/Fzlotm1gQzw**](https://youtu.be/Fzlotm1gQzw)

# **❌ The Problem:**

Travel and transport companies spend billions on outsourced customer support, and the experience for travelers is among the worst of any industry. Long waits and frustrating conversations with agents who are underpaid, poorly trained, and burned out by repetitive work are the norm. These failures aren’t accidents, they are the predictable outcome of how the system is built.

Traditional business process outsourcing companies (BPOs) are designed to handle high-volume, repetitive work at lower cost than hiring a fully in-house team, but the tradeoffs in customer experience are steep. The model relies on large pools of low-wage, undertrained workers, and gaps in language or cultural context make interactions slower and less effective. For travelers, that means slow, inconsistent support and unresolved problems. For travel companies, it means unhappy customers.

# **✅ The Solution:**

We’re replacing the old outsourcing model. Instead of relying on massive teams of low-wage human workers, we rely on voice and text AI agents that scale instantly, operate around the clock, and deliver consistent service every time.

Our AI contact center covers both front-office support, for example, airlines handling flight changes, seat requests, or baggage questions, and also back-office tasks such as processing ticket exchanges, issuing refunds, and updating reservations. By automating both the customer conversations and the follow-up tasks, requests are resolved quickly and without handoffs.

For travelers, this means getting help right away and leaving with a resolution instead of frustration. For travel companies, it means keeping the efficiencies of outsourcing while finally delivering the level of service that makes customers happy.

# **🙏 Our Ask:**

Outsourcing is broken. It’s time to rebuild it with AI. If you know leaders at airlines, travel agencies, travel management companies, or large transport providers who care about customer experience, we’d love to chat. And if you’re an investor who wants to be part of replacing the old model, now’s the time.

Email: [**founders@humoniq.ai**](mailto:founders@humoniq.ai)

long_description:
𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐰𝐞 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬:
I (Angel) have had three knee surgeries since my mid-teens and was billed more than $250K for care that should have cost a fraction of that. Fighting those inflated charges was so painful that we set out to build a consumer-facing AI agent to do it for others. In less than five months, we helped sixty patients erase or reduce over $300K from their medical bills.

This inspired us to fix the problem farther upstream: stopping bad payments before the patient ever sees a bill. So we launched payment integrity, machine-learning models that audit every medical claim for self-insured employers and health plans in real time.

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐦:
• Self-insured employers waste $60 B+ each year on claims that never should have been paid. Healthcare is the 2nd largest company expense after payroll.

• Manual audits are slow and partial: Reviewers focus only on high-dollar claims, letting millions more slip through unnoticed.

• Existing audit software is static: Decades-old rule engines can’t keep pace with evolving codes, contracts, or billing tactics.

• Incentives are misaligned: Third-party administrators are paid to process claims, not to police them, so accuracy checks are minimal.

𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐒𝐨𝐥𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧:

launches.title: F4 - Automated compliance checks for engineering drawings
launches.tagline: We help hardware teams 10x how they redline & interpret engineering drawings
launches.body:
# **What is F4 in a nutshell?**

We’re helping hardware-rich teams 10x how they redline and interpret engineering GD&T drawings. With backgrounds at Tesla and SpaceX, we’re building a platform that finally treats drawings like code—automatically validating every dimension, tolerance, and GD&T symbol against standards so noncompliance is caught instantly.

https://youtu.be/SYzqZ4XWmCA

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/a6d6c66e-7e58-4405-b4e2-48c30b354495)

# **The Problem & Why We Built F4**

Drawing literacy is one of the weakest skills across hardware teams. Yet drawings are made every day.

These aren’t just illustrations—they’re effectively business contracts between designers and manufacturers, defining what’s acceptable in production. Drawings carry the bulk of design intent—fit, form, function, and fabrication—and act as the important source of truth across production, quality, and supply chain.

GD&T standards from ASME and ISO exist to formalize this communication. But they’re dense and confusing. Across major revision years, there are thousands of pages of definitions, edge cases, and revision quirks. Designers are expected to know it all, leads are expected to catch every mistake, and suppliers are expected to interpret drawings flawlessly. One mistake means scrap, delays, or worse.

# **Our Solution**

Why is something so critical still so manual? Why can’t drawings be validated and interpreted more quickly and robustly —like code? Why can’t hardware dev be more like software dev?

We’re changing exactly that!

F4 treats drawings like code—they either execute or fail immediately. Our platform checks every dimension, tolerance, and GD&T symbol against standards in real-time, ensuring full compliance before a drawing ever reaches the floor. No more total reliance on manual redlining and reviews.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/1aa5904c-3086-4722-8838-ffda9c0d7a85)

F4 ensures engineers never release noncompliant drawings—and suppliers never misinterpret them. F4 helps industrial teams eliminate costly scrap, rework, and miscommunication at the root.

# **How It Works**

1. Upload a drawing (dxf…and very soon pdf)
2. Select GD&T standard of choice (ASME Y14.5 - 1994, 2009, & 2018)
3. Get instant compliance score graded against a desired GD&T standard using **deterministic logic**
4. Get recommendation to correct any asset (FCF, FOS, datum, basic, modifier, and/or dimension) of the drawing that is noncompliant with references to ground-truth sources
5. With a compliant drawing - get standard definition, inspection plan, and tolerance analysis interpretations on any drawing asset of interest

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/accc67da-db20-423d-84b0-7ec4904ad800)

## **Hardware Platform Built by Hardware Engineers!**

I worked at Tesla as a Mechanical Design Engineer and took 6 parts from clean sheet design to production for the CyberCab and SEMI drive system programs. I was also the lead engineer for Tesla’s global drive unit heat exchanger program with +3 million unit annual production volume.

Aidan worked at SpaceX as an Avionics Test Engineer, where he designed and owned testing hardware (PCB boards and testing apparatus) for the Raptor 3 Engine - the most advanced rocket engine in the world. 

In college, we led The University of Alabama’s Rocket Team where we achieved the university’s first-ever liquid rocket engine hotfire! I built the rocket engine and Aidan built the electrical/software for our propulsion system.

https://youtube.com/shorts/rBwsqu_sdeg?si=RgRU_eqib7_-qLcV

## **Ready to Ditch Manual Redlining?**

launches.title: Locata - AI Referral Management for Health Centers
launches.tagline: We use AI to automate the entire referral loop including authorizations, patient communication and specialist follow-up.
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Alejandro](https://www.linkedin.com/in/asalinas21/) and [Josh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joshua-r-chang/) - cofounders of [Locata](https://www.locatahealth.com/) 👋

**TL;DR**

Referral management is one of the most time-consuming and error-prone tasks in healthcare. Locata eliminates that burden by automating the entire process with AI. This helps health centers streamline their operations, reduce costs, and ensure patients get timely care.

https://youtu.be/IwyUifa8MnE

## ❌ The Problem

Referrals are one of the most critical, yet most broken, parts of the US healthcare system. Health centers are required to track specialist referrals to ensure continuity of patient care and meet quality standards. **But with limited staff and overwhelming administrative demands, health centers struggle to keep up, leading many to outsource the work.**

**Consequences:**

* High error rates in referrals
* Denied authorizations and delays in specialist appointments
* Wasted time manually copying data between various systems

**Impact:**

These operational inefficiencies create major **financial risks** for health centers. On top of the resources centers already deploy to manage referrals, failure to effectively close the loop puts quality standards in jeopardy, carrying even greater financial implications.

## [👷](https://emojipedia.org/construction-worker) Our Solution

Locata uses AI to automate the referral management process from end-to-end. Imagine having a team of the world’s best referral coordinators that operate with higher accuracy, lower costs, and faster delivery, giving health centers the capacity to scale on demand and close more referral loops.

* **AI auth submission**: Our AI extracts patient data directly from EHRs, intelligently maps it to the correct authorization forms across different payor portals, and submits requests automatically.
* **Automated status updates:** We monitor authorization status continuously, with automatic notifications sent to staff for cases requiring urgent attention.
* **Voice AI patient follow-up:** Our Voice AI calls patients on customizable cadences to monitor whether they’ve made a specialist appointment. Our system alerts staff when they need to step in to offer additional support.
* **Consult note retrieval**: Once a patient confirms an appointment, our AI automatically contacts specialists, requesting consult notes to effortlessly close the loop.

Within two weeks of building our product, we signed a major regional health center and are taking them live to automate their entire referral workflow.

## 🙏 Our Ask

* We would love introductions to physicians or administrative staff at health centers. Contact us at [**founders@locata.ai**](mailto:founders@locata.ai).
* Learn more at [**locatahealth.com**](http://locatahealth.com)

## 👫 The Team

Alejandro and Josh have known each other for almost 10 years.

Alejandro was a senior software engineer at Meta’s Reality Labs, where he led AI projects that resulted in a patent submission. He holds a BS degree in Computer Science from Stanford University. As an undergrad, he conducted AI research at Stanford Medicine and shadowed doctors internationally.

Josh was a software engineer at Google, working on AI products that served over 1 billion users. He holds BS & MS degrees in Computer Science from Stanford University.

launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91579&key=user_uploads/978619/4443ca80-d250-46a5-8234-98a9d5852a59)

Hey 👋, we’re Haz and Wyatt, the founders of Pally.

We’re building Pally because in a world full of ‘AI SDRs’, our warm connections become more important than ever… Yet today, keeping track of thousands of connections across countless social platforms is impossible. 

We forget to respond, we miss important moments, and we lose touch.

We’re building Pally to solve that.

If this resonates, we’d love your early feedback. Download Pally here: [www.pally.com](http://www.pally.com)

# Demo

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g97sd_roD14

## How does it work?

We bring together all your connections, across all your socials (inc. iMessage, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Google, Email, Calendar, and X), and then our AI researches everything they’ve ever posted online.

Pally uses this deep understanding of each relationship to help you:

* Prepare you for meetings
* Stay in touch with your potential customers/hires/investors (or just remind you to ring your mum from time to time)
* Search over your network to find the right person for any query (”who do I know in New York that I’ve not spoken to in a while?”)
* Add people to pipelines

We also added some fun relationship stats, so you can see how social you are compared to other Pally users, how each relationship is growing/declining over time, how long you take to reply vs how long others take to reply to you, and more.

## Who’s it for?

We’re mostly focused on founders and investors, but we’ve also seen salespeople, recruiters, agency owners, and creators get a lot of value from Pally; essentially anyone in a role where relationships are a primary focus (and honestly, we believe in the world of AI, that’s _everyone_).

## What's next?

We're excited to launch this into public beta today, learn from what our users are loving, and where they’re wanting more, and build that. 

Our roadmap includes adding integrations with AI meeting note takers, so all your relationship context is in one place, adding an iOS app so you have all your data on the go, and adding more agentic capabilities.

# Ask

Please upvote us here and on [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/products/pally-ai-relationship-management), and give Pally a test and let us know how you get on! 

We’re also hiring! If you’re interested in working with us, please email [hiring@pally.com](mailto:hiring@pally.com) with your cv.

Thanks for your support,

Haz + Wyatt 🫶

**TLDR;** Notte provides a platform to build and deploy web AI agents that don’t break. We turn messy, repetitive web tasks into reliable, self-healing workflows so businesses can scale automation with confidence.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uwTOpQTUfyk

**Context**

We built Notte because the web was made for humans, not AI agents. Our first product was a perception layer that helps LLMs parse and understand site structure, boosting agents’ performance. But 90% isn’t enough to scale enterprise workflows with confidence.

**Agent Workflows**

That’s why we launched **Agent Workflows** - where web automation meets agentic reasoning. Start an agent to discover the workflow, freeze the routine into deterministic steps, and keep agents only where it’s needed to unlock new capabilities. If a site changes, agents dynamically close the gap to ensure workflows never break.

Less tokens = Less expensive = More control = Faster automation

**Full-stack Ecosystem**

* **Hosted Sessions** - Stealth mode and auto-scaling browser
* **Vaults** - Credentials, MFA tokens, SSO, and cookies securely
* **Personas** - Emails and phone numbers for account creations

**TL;DR:** 

Creating motion graphics is time-consuming and requires complicated software. Hera uses AI to make motion design radically faster and cheaper, helping users create over 50,000 animations to date.

**Problem: Motion design is complicated, time-consuming, and expensive**

Peter used to build YouTube channels and produced more than 240 videos. He spent thousands of dollars every week hiring motion designers to create infographics, text animations, or map animations. 

There he realized that motion design is mostly about mastering complicated software with many buttons, not actual creative work. Here you can see how complicated, tedious, and time-consuming the leading tool, Adobe After Effects, is:

It answers every call, 24/7 — taking orders, processing deliveries, booking reservations, upselling, and handling complaints in English, Spanish, French and more. Certus is built to manage the phone line end to end, from the customer call to the restaurant tech stack, with zero human intervention required. It currently integrates with industry-leading systems like Toast, Square, Clover, UberEats, DoorDash, and more.

We’re building the voice layer of the modern restaurant — the employee they’ll never fire.

We started Certus because we lived the pain. Gurveer (CEO) grew up answering phones in his family’s restaurant and helped operate them, growing from 1 to 11 locations in 7 years. Later, he and Adam (CRO) ran a restaurant growth startup to help others increase revenue, but kept watching clients bleed cash because no one picked up the phone. So we built the solution the industry always wished existed.

Until now, this problem was considered unsolvable. But Voice AI has finally crossed the conversational chasm and 72% of consumers now prefer AI over humans as long as it means faster and better service.

More importantly, the market is begging for this. The North American restaurant industry crossed $1 trillion in 2024, and it's projected to hit $1.5 trillion in 2025. Yet over $100 billion is still lost annually to missed calls, human error, and outdated tech. As the market continues to grow, so do the losses!

Our customers say it best:

- “Certus changed my life overnight.”
- “We were losing the ability to give great in-house service — the phone was killing us.”
-  “70% of my business comes through the phone. That’s mine and my 16 staffs livelihood.”
- “Before Certus, I used to lose 40 - 60 calls a day…. now my printer just stays printing!”
-  “I’ve been in the business 38 years. I’ve been waiting for this since then.”

Certus is here to fix the $120B phone problem — one call at a time.

And in doing so, we’re redefining how the restaurant industry communicates forever, starting with the phone line.

**TL;DR**

Bulk inventory is hard to track. Most companies still rely on rough estimates or expensive surveys that often miss the mark. We built Rebulk to fix that. Our drones and cameras scan your site and create a precise 3D reconstruction, so you always know exactly how much material is on the ground. Bulk inventory tracking is broken. Companies either rely on guesstimates or pay for expensive manual surveys which are still off by 20 to 30 percent. launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're Mahyad and Saurav, the founders of Okibi.

**TL;DR** [Okibi.ai](http://Okibi.ai) turns your product into a CLI, so AI agents can use it just like your users do.

Agents are becoming the main users of our apps and softwares, but most of those products still aren't designed to be fully usable by agents.

DoorDash, Mercury, Gusto, and 30+ others have already launched agent-ready CLIs.

**Okibi generates yours.**

<https://youtu.be/LANzB5DZ7_s>

### **Problem**

**The shift.** Work has quietly moved into agentic tools like Claude and Codex. The person who used to open your app now sends their agent. Agents create 90% of new Supabase databases and 2/3 of Mintlify docs traffic.

**The gap.** Agents can read everything, but signing up, configuring a project, or placing an order, is another story. With MCPs, you'll give the agent too many tools at once and it'll start using the wrong ones. With direct API calls, the agent has to individually call endpoints for complex workflows or polling loops.

**The turn.** Claude Code and Codex proved it; agents do their best work in the terminal, and a CLI is how your product shows up there. No tools need to load up front, because agents can discover what they need when they need it through progressive disclosure with --help, and all complex workflows are pre-built so it doesn't have to figure it out on the fly.

**The proof.** Companies are already shipping agent-ready CLIs. Even Notion, with one of the best-known MCP servers, shipped one.

An agent that struggles to use a product will go to a competitor that it won't struggle with.

**Okibi is how you become that competitor.**

### **How it works**

Building a toy wrapper CLI is easy. Building an agent-ready production CLI is a different story.

**Research.** Okibi **reads all of your APIs, SDKs, MCPs, and researches similar products** to yours and defines the standard for your product's commands.

**Build.** We build your entire product as commands in a CLI, with structured JSON output, descriptive errors, and dry-runs with input validation.

**Customize.** You can keep customizing the commands that are generated through our agent.

**Verify.** This isn't just "it compiles". Commands run in a real sandbox, the outputs are checked, and **the CLI is fully evaled for agent use.**

**Ship.** You get a compiled binary with a skill file baked in, so an agent that installs it already knows how to use your product.

**Maintain.** Whenever your product updates, **Okibi mints the changes and maintains your CLI for you.**

**Identity.** Even with a CLI, an agent can't set up an account for your user. With **Okibi Identity, the agent can set up the account** and continue working uninterrupted. And that's how you get agents as customers!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114523&key=user_uploads/539005/aaf9f512-390f-4a14-85ca-9bfb8db5a29c)

### **About us**

We've been building software together for almost a decade, and this is our second YC startup. At SigmaOS (S21) we built the first browser with built-in agents. Since then, every time we wanted our agents to use a product, we generated a CLI for it, since MCPs weren't enough for the job. It happened enough times that we're now building it for everyone.

### **Our ask to you**

If you are building a product that you want agents to use, **please reach out to us**! We would love to learn what you are building and how you are letting agents use your product.

You can also head over to [okibi.ai](http://okibi.ai) to turn your product into a CLI

Book a call: <https://calendly.com/m-cal-uvfs/okibi-customer-call>

Email: [m@okibi.ai](mailto:m@okibi.ai)

Juxta is creating the first Universal Positioning System (UPS) — a GPS alternative that can monitor movement anywhere on earth with no new hardware, minimal internet connection, and remote deployment. Using custom machine learning models and a first-of-its-kind synthetic fingerprinting technology, Juxta can make any indoor, outdoor, or underground space location-aware in minutes for a fraction of the cost of any other geospatial technology.

Juxta's UPS can be leveraged across industries — from securely tracking soldiers in combat zones to providing offline positioning for robots to offering asset tracking in warehouses and ports around the globe.
one_liner: Building a GPS alternative 100x more powerful with no hardware needed.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Prev. Northwestern data science + journalism; CEO at Juxta, working to create the next frontier of asset and personnel tracking!

launches.title: Juxta — a GPS alternative 100x more powerful, with zero external hardware.
launches.tagline: Track anyone, anything, anywhere on earth in an instant.
launches.body:
Hi! We’re building Juxta — a new way to track people and things anywhere around the world with zero external hardware required (i.e. satellites, beacons, free-floating chips, etc). We let businesses, defense agencies, and consumers instantly map an area and make it location aware in minutes. It’s super cheap, can work offline, is unjammable, and has truly universal coverage.

https://youtu.be/9A8X8NIbPBM

**Why current tracking methods don’t work**

Most tracking technologies today fail where people actually live and work. Over 90% of human activity happens indoors, yet GPS simply doesn’t function in enclosed spaces, and beacon systems like BLE or UWB cost upwards of $250,000 per site to install and maintain. Even outdoors, GPS breaks down in forests, dense urban areas, warzones, and remote regions—anywhere signal is weak, jammed, or obstructed. These limitations make traditional tracking systems expensive, unreliable, and fundamentally incomplete for real-world use.

**Introducing the Universal Positioning System (UPS)**

* Zero hardware, all on-device.
* **Remotely deployable: map anywhere _from_ anywhere**
* **Works anywhere: indoors, outdoors, underground.**
* Capable offline, unjammable, end-to-end encrypted.
* Tracks anything with an IMU: phones, robots, vehicles, machinery.
* Juxta delivers GPS-level (or better) accuracy at a fraction of the cost — with 10x the global coverage.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91937&key=user_uploads/1967850/5c399c68-3b89-4f55-b150-21d0e11d6ce9)

**How UPS works**

1. Upload floorplans or satellite imagery to our web portal.
2. We vectorize layouts, generate 3D spaces, and simulate millions of hyper-realistic movement paths.
3. AI trains on this synthetic data to reduce drift.
4. Models deploy directly to user devices — **no manual setup or hardware required.**

**It already works and has tons of applications**

* _Defense:_ Track personnel/assets in the field — no signals needed or frequencies emitted.
* _Robotics:_ Signed deals with companies like RC Mowers needing non-visual, offline positioning.
* _Warehousing/Logistics:_ Track assets in ports/facilities with no beacon install.
* _Healthcare:_ LOI signed to track patients via existing medical monitors.

**Get started with hardware-free, remotely deployable tracking…**

* Book a demo at: [usejuxta.org](http://usejuxta.org)
* Email me: [john@usejuxta.org](mailto:john@usejuxta.org)

We do this by enabling remote teleoperation. We then use the teleoperated excavators to collect the datasets needed to automate the machines.

https://youtu.be/Kpbor3M6Mr8

**🚧Problem**

Construction industry has some troubling trends:

* **1 million worker shortage** in the US alone
* **1000+ deaths annually** from safety incidents (and rising)
* **Hundreds of thousands in penalties** + multi-week shutdowns per incident
* **40% operational downtime** due to blind spots and inefficiencies

It’s **Dull, Dirty, Dangerous**, dialed to the max!

The problem is global and getting worse as the workforce ages and recruitment plummets.

**👷The Flywheel Solution**

**🚜Retrofit**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92796&key=user_uploads/367031/4e9829e3-a90f-4d93-b08f-d17cb961ea7f)

We engineered a new way to retrofit heavy equipment, which is machine-agnostic and compatible with pretty much any hydraulic equipment. These can be installed in few hours and don’t block manual operations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92796&key=user_uploads/367031/cb9452e8-c8eb-4b0f-9a2f-37cfb58a1314)

We built a low-latency remote teleop + dataset collection platform with the ability to remotely turn on/off the machines and let supervisors take over at any time. This enables controlling the fleet even from a minimal setup of laptop and joysticks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92796&key=user_uploads/367031/a75da0c3-ee2b-4b86-9f6f-5108e7a5423b)

We use data from actual operations and robot learning to train models which does various tasks like dig and dump, trenching, grading and more. This will enable a single operator to manage more machines and sites at the same time.

**We’re Flywheel AI**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92796&key=user_uploads/367031/e752210f-530c-4dd4-9b25-475ea1137089)

Jash previously built remote teleop tool with companies like Accenture as users. Mahi built the data and ML pipeline at Motional which runs over 50K simulations everyday. Together we have built various robots and spent many hours on the sites in hard hats and safety shoes!

If you or a construction contractor/sub-contractor you know struggles with site safety and operator performance,[ book a meeting](https://calendly.com/jash-mota/flywheel-sales) to learn more about our solution and installation process!

We’re **Julian** and **Glenn**, and we’ve built **stagewise** because we wanted to quickly iterate on app frontends with AI - even if they’re not just simple prototypes anymore, but real projects.

**AI-powered app builders work great - until they don’t.**

Once you move into a production-grade project setup on your local machine, you lose the awesome experience of visually building your apps frontend with simple prompts.

With stagewise, we’ve developed an **open-source** and **framework-independent** toolbar that brings our frontend coding agent **right into your web app on localhost**.\

Here’s how it works:\

The toolbar has already surpassed **4,800 GitHub-stars** ⭐️ and **130,000 downloads 📈**

_We believe that the best user experiences are built by **iterating fast** and putting yourselves **in the shoes of your user**._

launches.title: Fleetline 🚛 Optimizing Fleet Planning with Data Driven Algorithms
launches.tagline: Combining LLMs with advanced optimization to unlock algorithmic load planning for all fleets, in all situations
launches.body:
# TLDR:

Today’s fleets are **stuck between two failing approaches to load planning**: human dispatchers drowning in complexity (driver preferences, regulatory constraints, shifting schedules, and more) or inflexible algorithms blind to tribal knowledge and driver nuance. We solve this by combining advanced optimization with LLMs that can adapt algorithms to deliver intelligent planning for real-world operations. \
https://youtu.be/9LHYILVw6ks

# **💥 The problem:**

Planning just one week of routes for a 50-truck fleet involves **more possible combinations than there are grains of sand on Earth**. For humans, consistently piecing together reasonable combinations is difficult. Making optimal ones is impossible. Dispatchers juggle:

* Regulatory constraints, like drivers’ hours of service
* Complex forecasts, like considering the likelihood of receiving a load from a flaky customer
* And human preferences, like a driver’s disdain for a specific commodity

This complexity forces fleets to effectively **silo their operations**—assigning each dispatcher a subset of trucks to manage. **Instead of coordinating as a cohesive operation, fleets become mini-operations, resulting in load mismatches and under-utilized capacity.** For a low-margin industry like trucking, those inefficiencies are the difference between making or missing payroll. 

In response, some fleets have adopted expensive load planning algorithms. While these traditional solutions are a marginal improvement over manual work, they fail to meaningfully solve the problem. 

Rigid algorithms operate like complete black boxes, often leaving dispatchers with a lack of confidence in their decisions. Deterministic algorithms cannot be responsive to the soft preferences of either the fleet or the driver. For example, dispatchers may have to reshuffle their planning board because an algorithm cannot optimize for a driver needing to be home early one day for his daughter’s recital. 

That means the algorithm's recommendations are largely not followed or, if they are, drivers are left unhappy. With an active driver shortage, fleets can’t tolerate the latter. 

Trucking is a trillion-dollar industry, yet its biggest players have no good option for load planning. 

# **✅ The solution:**

**Fleets no longer have to choose between two existentially threatening options with Fleetline.** By combining traditional advanced optimizations with LLMs, we created a solution that allows fleets to optimize their schedules while being adaptive to soft preferences and surprises. All users need to do is prompt our AI agent with any changes / added constraints to include in the optimization algorithm, and the load planning is re-done. 

For example, if a driver at a fleet needs to make it back home by 2 PM on a given Tuesday to see his daughter’s recital, instead of manually scrambling the planning board, our AI agent can re-optimize around the new constraint. 

We’re already working with large fleets in California and talking to others across the country.

# **🏋️‍♂️ The team:**

Saurav and Veer are lifelong friends who have been working on projects together since they were 14. Saurav graduated from UIUC and has worked at Icon, Meta, and Nvidia, and is a previous founder (Blast AI). Veer was pursuing his master’s at USC, was a nationally ranked high school and college debater, and is an exited founder. 

We’re excited about building revolutionary tech for a trillion-dollar industry that is functionally the backbone of the country. 

# **📈 Vision:**

A dynamic algorithm unlocked by LLMs will allow fleets of any size to find value in our optimization software. 

### **Our ask:**

Please let us know if you have any connections at all in the trucking or logistics space 🙂\
Would also love to talk to anyone who has built RL environments or dynamic programming algorithms at scale!

\
Contact us at [founders@fleetline.ai](mailto:founder@fleetline.ai)

name: Magnetic
long_description:
Magnetic scans client documents - from handwritten charity notes to excel spreadsheet Schedule Cs to multi-state K-1s - and enters them into tax software automatically, saving hours of tedious data entry. 

The accounting profession is facing a massive talent shortage, as graduates choose different professions and the old guard begins to retire. As a result, CPA and tax preparation firms are awash in clientele, but unable to keep up. At many firms, phones go unanswered, clients are "fired", and websites are taken down, as the existing workforce tries to handle the grueling 80 hour+ weeks necessary to push through tax season to the April 15th deadline.

We built this because a former colleague who owns her own tax firm asked us to automate her workload, and we quickly realized the massive opportunity. Thomas brings deep domain expertise as the former Head of Product at Keeper (YC W19), where he built tax engine automation systems and an OCR form scanning system that outperformed everything else on the market. At Keeper, he leveraged early access to OpenAI's LLMs (well before ChatGPT) to build systems that automated the entire tax filing process, allowing a tiny team of CPAs to process thousands of returns with near zero busy work. Patrick was the first engineer at FunCraft, shipping multiple mobile games with 1M+ downloads and building scalable shared codebases. We've worked together since 2017, including co-leading multiple teams at Zynga as PM & Tech Lead respectively.

The opportunity is massive - there are 80M US personal tax returns filed via professionals annually, in a $2B outsourcing market where individual CPA firms currently pay $100k-$1M per year for inferior services. We're positioned to capture significant market share by offering better accuracy & document coverage, instant processing, and superior user experience.

We've built this kind of software before, we've worked together for years (and even lived together), we've built products to $10M ARR before, and we have the grit to outwork anyone in this space.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Magnetic scans taxpayer documents and enters them into tax software automatically, replacing data entry roles and reducing costly errors for CPA firms.

**Ask**: Know a firm struggling with tax prep capacity? We’d love an intro.

https://youtu.be/5--kYPgPLEM

---

**The Problem:**

The accounting profession is in crisis. CPAs and other tax professionals face a massive talent shortage as new grads abandon the field and experienced pros retire or sell their firms to PE. Firms are overwhelmed, working 80+ hour weeks during tax season, turning away clients, and missing deadlines - not due to a lack of work, but a lack of bandwidth. Many of the firms we talk to either don’t have a working website or don’t pick up the phone - because they can’t handle new clients.

Most CPA firms still rely on manual data entry or expensive outsourcing services that are slow, error-prone, and hard to scale.

---

**Our Solution:**

Magnetic automates tax data entry. We scan client docs - from handwritten donation notes to messy Schedule Cs and multi-state K-1s - and enter the data directly into legacy tax software like UltraTax, Drake, or ProConnect with 90%+ field-level accuracy (vs \~50% from incumbents).

The agent can even reason over complex documents, reference the tax code, and perform calculations to handle nuanced scenarios like allocating tax-exempt interest across states for compliance with state apportionment rules.

name: Modelence
long_description:
You built your product in a weekend and deployed to Vercel, Supabase, Railway or AWS. Now you need to figure out how to pick the right region, scale to multiple instances, add monitoring and alerts, and who to ping when something breaks… and you don't have a cloud engineer.

We spent a decade at our previous startup (CodeSignal), building a $500M platform while scaling to millions of users and customers like Meta & Netflix. Now we're standardizing how web applications are operated in production, so developers can build reliable production apps without becoming cloud infrastructure experts.

Modelence is a production cloud that's designed for enterprise-grade apps, abstracting away the infrastructure layer:
- Deployments & hosting
- Background jobs and persistence
- File storage, real-time data and networking
- Monitoring and alerts

Platforms like Vercel and Supabase are easy to start with, but most companies that start getting real customers eventually need a persistent backend where processes can run beyond just a few minutes at a time, unlike pure serverless. And low-level cloud platforms like AWS are meant to be operated by cloud engineers and are too complicated for engineers who want to focus on product rather than infra. Modelence is your managed backend infrastructure, built on decades of our experience operating web apps in the cloud.
one_liner: Production infrastructure on autopilot

launches.title: Modelence: all-in-one TypeScript platform for startups
launches.tagline: Ship production AI apps 10x faster with built-in auth, database and LLM integration
launches.body:
You built the demo in a weekend. Now you need auth, a prod-grade database, real-time events, AI observability, cron jobs, email, monitoring… and you needed them yesterday.

We spent a decade building platforms while scaling to millions of users and enterprise customers. Now we put that into an open-source framework, so others wouldn’t have to do the same from scratch.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92593&key=user_uploads/2485356/d6404f4b-fb88-47d1-adcc-b895394e41af)

Modelence is a batteries-included framework that abstracts away boilerplate so you can just focus on building your product logic and nothing else - it’s like Next.js + Vercel + Supabase on a single platform, built for full-stack TypeScript.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S4f22FyPpI8

**Why Modelence?**

Shipping production apps is much harder than building a prototype that runs locally and 95% of all production apps share the same building blocks. We did a massive amount of work on our previous platforms that was not specific to our product, and we’ve created Modelence to abstract that away:

* Authentication
* Database setup
* Hosting / CDN
* AI integration (LLM observability, prompts)
* Real-time events
* Cron jobs
* Email service
* Monitoring
* Analytics
* Admin dashboards

Andrej Karpathy recently posted about this same exact problem - [**https://x.com/karpathy/status/1905051558783418370**](https://x.com/karpathy/status/1905051558783418370) and explained it further in his [**YC AI Startup School talk**](https://tinyurl.com/45xvsm3y).

**Who is this for?**

Startups that are shipping TypeScript production apps and want to focus on building their product without worrying about boilerplate, DevOps, infra and scaling.

**Founders**

* Aram S (ex-Principal Eng @ Intuit, co-founded [**CodeSignal**](https://codesignal.com/))
* Eduard P, PhD (Founding Eng @ [**CodeSignal**](https://codesignal.com/))

**Getting Started**

Modelence is open-source - go to https://modelence.com to create a free cloud environment and try it!

launches.body:
Hey YC.

My name is Eshan. I’ve spent the last 5 years trying to address what I think is the most pressing problem in the country — addiction and mental health. Before YC, I ran a group doing on the ground overdose prevention work across the country. I also worked at the White House on Drug Policy.

**Insurance companies love to scrutinize behavioral health treatment**, partially because it’s expensive (a single 30-day residential treatment episode can cost upwards of $50,000), and partially because proving medical necessity for behavioral health is a subjective process.

But behavioral health care _is_ medically necessary. **Drug overdose is the single biggest cause of death for young people in the US.** And there are too many stories of insurers denying people care, only for those individuals to later lose their lives to overdose.

We were in the summer ‘25 YC batch. Since then, we’ve been working with a small group of customers to develop a new product. I’m excited to announce it today.\
\
**Introducing: Perspectives Reclaim**

Because they’re under so much pressure from payors, behavioral health treatment programs currently spend an immense amount of resources and staff generating documentation and auditing it to be perfect. \
\
Reclaim solves this by

1. Reading tens of thousands of pages of charts every night
2. Finding issues that can lead to insurance denials or other issues
3. Tracking down which clinician made the error and emailing back and forth with them until it’s solved.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101622&key=user_uploads/2329278/a7ccf9c3-cf38-409a-a8d4-9c4421623a19)

\
In each of our pilots, we’ve flagged and resolved hundreds of issues, from missing documents to drug tests that weren’t happening when they were supposed to, **leading to more approvals from payors, higher revenue for our clinics, and better outcomes for patients.**

Reclaim’s agent can also help provide evidence when fighting against payor clawbacks and can generate the insurance documentation used to argue for more days of care.

In the last 4 weeks since launching Reclaim, we’ve gone from **0 —> $250k cARR.** Our vision is to replace the $30B spent on the financial and administrative services that keep these clinics afloat and give that capacity back to care.

**Asks**:

1. Intros to our ICP: we’re looking for multi-site behavioral health/SUD treatment centers that deal with commercial insurance.
2. We’re currently hiring a senior software engineer to help us scale. Any intros here would be appreciated.
3. Investor intros are always appreciated as well.

Here’s our launch video: <https://youtu.be/vvFe7AF3mUo>

AI is rapidly improving, but most of healthcare is locked out due to legacy systems. Perspectives bridges that gap, making AI usable immediately. Clinicians want to help people. Not to be drowned in manual work. We're building toward a future where clinicians never touch a keyboard for documentation again—where intelligent systems handle every workflow outside of patient care. 

The first step is integrating seamlessly with outdated EMRs and filling in the critical workflows they lack. From there, we'll expand across specialties—behavioral health, speech therapy, physical therapy, veterinary care, and beyond—unlocking AI for every provider outside the hospital system.

name: Duranium
long_description:
China and Russia control the world’s critical minerals. We can produce Titanium, Magnesium, Aluminum, Zirconium & Hafnium in the U.S. more profitably than any existing process, and carbon neutrally via co-production.

Carbochlorination is the primary process for producing critical metals like titanium, hafnium, and zirconium, and was once the standard for magnesium. The problem: conventional carbochlorination relies on purchasing carbon feedstocks, wastes valuable byproducts, and is highly CO₂-intensive.

Duranium changes this with a novel reactor that recycles CO₂ emissions back into feedstock (CO) while generating a valuable co-product (bleaching agents). This closed loop slashes emissions and delivers Chinese-level metal pricing without subsidies — unlocking the full potential of carbochlorination for U.S. critical mineral production.
