launches.tagline: Reshoring critical light-weight metal production (Ti, Mg, Al, Zr, Hf) — more profitably than any other method through modernized carbochlorination and co-production.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93706&key=user_uploads/2509424/cab46185-5d50-4822-bf45-873f52ae6571)

**TL;DR** — **China and Russia control world’s critical minerals. We can produce Titanium, Magnesium, Aluminum, Zirconium & Hafnium in the U.S. more profitably than any existing process, and carbon neutrally. On track to supply 12% of U.S. magnesium by 2029, at 50%+ EBITDA margins (@ world’s lowest mkt prices).**

Hi all, we’re Berkley and Brenden of Duranium, and we’re delivering American critical mineral independence with a light-weight metal production process that competes globally without subsidies. As brothers-in-law, we’re passionate about rebuilding the U.S. industrial base — not through taxes and subsidies, but through real technological innovation. Our mission is to help America reclaim its place as the world’s greatest builder of _tangible_ things.

# ❌ The Problem

Magnesium, titanium, aluminum, hafnium, and zirconium are all listed on the DOE’s Critical Minerals List, with magnesium ranked among the highest in both supply risk and strategic importance to U.S. energy security. _The U.S. has zero domestic magnesium production and no titanium sponge production — yet both are indispensable for fighter jets, missiles, satellites, rockets, and advanced aerospace systems._ 

China and Russia control \~97% of magnesium and \~90% of titanium production (directly or indirectly). 

On top of that, U.S. magnesium costs nearly 3x the global average, and legacy methods are CO₂-intensive and waste valuable byproducts.

# ✨ Our Solution

We’ve modernized carbochlorination metallurgy (the primary methods for producing many of these critical metals) with a novel reactor and process that:

* Creates a closed-loop system that profitably matches Chinese pricing — without subsidies — and slashes emissions
* Recycles CO₂ emissions into CO feedstock
* Generates a valuable co-product (bleaching agents)

Others are trying to reinvent lightweight metal production from scratch with approaches that are costly and dependent on government subsidies or green premiums to hit profitability. Our approach is different: we harness the laws of thermodynamics instead of fighting them, co-producing valuable outputs that make the economics best-in-class.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93706&key=user_uploads/2509424/38fd63f0-e5a7-4f91-88cf-ad06c8b7e01a)

# 🏆 What we’ve achieved so far and where we’re headed

* We’ve proven the process at benchtop scale, producing magnesium, bleaching agents, and converting CO₂ produced by carbochlorination into CO
* We are now scaling with the build of a pilot facility to be operational by June 2026
* We’re on track to supply 12% of U.S. magnesium by 2029, at 50%+ EBITDA margins (@ world’s lowest mkt prices)

# 👥 Our Team

Berkley, CTO — A leading American expert in magnesium production; holds a patent for an electrochemical metal cell and built the _only_ U.S. pilot magnesium electrolyzer in the last 20+ years. Brings unmatched technical depth in lightweight metal production

Brenden, CEO — Former McKinsey D.C. consultant, where he advised the DoD on reshoring critical chemical production and spent 1 year with the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA). Ex-Goldman TMT investment banker, Stanford Law graduate and Knight-Hennessy Scholar

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93706&key=user_uploads/2509424/babe8628-8537-44c5-aa1a-daecb483c077)

## 🙏 Asks

Join our team! We’re looking for engineers with experience in high-temperature or corrosive reactors. If that’s you — or someone you know — and you want to help build the future of lightweight metal production, get in touch!

launches.title: Tecto - Governance Platform for AI Employees 🤖

launches.body:
👋 Hi! We’re [Niosha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/afsharikia/) and [Roksana](https://www.linkedin.com/in/roksana-baleshzar/), co-founders of [Tecto](https://www.tecto.ai/).

# **TL;DR:**

We help your company identify roles that can be filled by agentic AI tools, onboard them quickly, monitor their performance and behavior, and ensure they stay compliant and aligned with policies. Tecto is building the **HR system for managing your AI “employees”**.  

🎬🍿

https://youtu.be/GeTHW1XVwvE

# **The Problem**

💸 Most companies are eager to **unlock the $B in efficiency** promised by AI, but unsure which use cases to start with. Should they bring on an AI email manager? Or a task manager that syncs with email? Or an all-in-one AI coordinator? 

📋 Even after choosing, the **approval process**—from vendor risk assessment to infosec, GRC, and legal—is slow and convoluted. And by the time it's complete, the tool or regulations may have already changed.

🐒 Moreover, agentic AI tools **aren’t static like traditional SaaS**. They continuously evolve with new models, multimodal capabilities, and dynamic behaviors. **Much like humans**, their responses can vary depending on context, drift to favor shortcuts, or adapt tone _([Chen et al., 2025](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.06366))_

📊 Most importantly, relying solely on **model benchmarks falls short**. Agent behavior is shaped by capability, context, and adaptation, not just the underlying model. For example:

* A single missed medical term in a transcription can lead to a hallucinated diagnosis in the summarization layer (error propagation) ☠️
* In a back-office copilot, the assistant began favoring shortcuts over accuracy after users consistently chose the fastest suggestions, optimizing for user approval instead of policy (favoring shortcuts)  💾

# **Our Solution**

**Tecto platform provides the evaluations and qualifications needed to employ and monitor agentic AI, like gusto for AI employees.**

* Tecto helps you pinpoint where AI fits within your workflow and matches you with a curated list of vetted AI employees aligned with your organization’s expectations, risk tolerance, and compliance requirements. 
* Once deployed, we continuously monitor their behavior—using output testing to detect drift, edge case failures, and other unexpected actions as they arise. 
* We also keep you ahead of rapidly evolving AI regulations worldwide, alerting you to public incidents or legal actions involving tools in your stack, so you can respond before issues escalate.

🕹️ With Tecto, onboarding AI employees is fast and oversight doesn’t stop after deployment. Your AI adoption is structured, controlled, and safe from day one.

# **Why We’re Building This**

Together, we bring over six years of firsthand experience navigating AI adoption—both inside and outside Silicon Valley—across technical development and real-world implementation.

**Niosha**, our CEO, has 10+ years experience navigating highly regulated spaces. She spent the last 6 years as a consultant after earning her PhD, helping the government and private sector bring AI from theory to practice. She’s seen the confusion, overwhelm, and lack of structure that plague even the most ambitious AI initiatives.

**Roksana**, our CTO, has been building software since she was a teenager and spent the last 6.5 years as an AI engineer at Google. She worked on applied AI at scale, navigating the practical challenges of evaluating tools, monitoring agent behavior in production, and aligning systems with compliance needs.

🎖️ We kept seeing the same pattern: companies either banned AI tools outright or used them blindly, leading to compliance failures, reputational damage, and eroded trust. So we built Tecto to close that gap—because real trust in AI adoption comes from having control.

# **Our Ask:**

We’re looking for:

**Enterprise teams** adopting (or planning to adopt) third-party AI tools or AI “employees”.

**GRC, Infosec, Vendor Risk Assessment , and IT leaders** (including CSOs) who need control over the AI behavior.

**Startups** that want to hire AI fast, but can’t afford to get it wrong.

**Developers** building AI employees, tools for workflow automation, or vertical AI who want to accelerate their sales.

If that’s you, we’d love to work with you!\
We’re offering early access and discounted pricing for our first wave of customers and hands-on support as you onboard.

👉 Sign up at [tecto.ai](https://www.tecto.ai/early-access)\

launches.title: Vulcan Technologies — Virginia Required Our Product by Law
launches.tagline: AI to Write Laws and Regulations
launches.body:
# Vulcan Technologies

**We are deleting red tape and replacing expensive consultants with AI tools that empower elected officials to actualize the public will and interest.**

[**Virginia Required Our Product by Law**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y43b3UvgJIg)

## Traction

* **Governor of Virginia**: Signed Executive Order last week embedding our invention, “AI agentic regulatory review,” into Virginia's regulatory processes, memorializing our ongoing contract
* **Acquired RegsBot**: Our biggest competitor
* **Advisory Board**: Stanford Hoover Institute economics PhD (20+ years regulatory research) + Top-5 law school JD (2 White House tours, 20+ years law/policy)

## The Problem

Elected officials — representatives, senators, governors, and presidents — write laws and executive orders to actualize their campaign promises and, in theory, serve the public will and interest. These newly-minted laws and executive orders are then passed to regulatory agencies in the executive branch, occupied by thousands of bureaucrats and contractors, who write regulations and guidance documents designed to implement laws and executive orders.

In the status quo, the regulatory implementation process is sluggish and highly bureaucratic. Each regulatory change must cohere with all existing state law, federal law, and case law; otherwise, agencies risk litigation and the loss of their budgets. Consequently, agencies spend millions of dollars and years hiring consultancies and law firms just to double-check that their proposed implementation of laws and executive orders is actually lawful.

Each step in this onerous and years-long iteration loop creates new arenas for political conflict, wastes taxpayer dollars, and means that the public will, exercised by elected officials, is not actually implemented.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92391&key=user_uploads/2746243/4e87c9c9-7341-4361-89f9-c6c663073ba2)

## Our Solution: AI Legal Cartography

Our agentic scraper reflects the entire American legal corpus (statutes, regulations, case law, in all jurisdictions) and our proprietary AI knowledge graph maps relationships between legal nodes. Examples: court precedent nullifies federal law, federal law supersedes state law, federal funding demands state compliance, etc.

Our system:

* Instantly redlines proposed regulations
* Responds to public comment
* Drafts legislative language
* Illuminates compliance violations while generating lawful alternatives

We enable elected officials and their appointees to execute policy changes without wasting time and tax dollars on legal complexities and consultant dependencies.

## The Team

We came together because we believe AI can and should strengthen America's democratic institutions.

**Tanner** turned down Harvard Law School and left his job as Technology and Regulatory Policy Director at Joe Lonsdale's Cicero Institute where he worked on AI and regulatory policy in 30 states. Previously he worked for Andrew Yang's presidential campaign and wrote his Dartmouth thesis about the "ontology of American regulation."

**Alek** dropped out of Dartmouth where he studied Machine Learning, was a chess champion, and a recipient of the Jack Byrne grant for Dartmouth's top math students. Alek also worked as an AI engineer at several startups before founding Vulcan.

**Chris** left Google where he built ML infrastructure for Gemini and Waymo. Before Google, Chris studied CS and Philosophy at Princeton. Chris became passionate about regulatory reform and leveraging AI to improve policy after following SF politics and the emergent abundance movement.

## Asks

* **Feedback on our vision** — we are building AI that empowers elected officials to implement durable policy changes

## Our Ideology

We see a dialectic in AI and government: totalitarianism (algorithmic control and surveillance undermining freedom) vs. humanism (AI empowering innovation and responsive government, unlocking unprecedented freedom, creativity, and individualism).

At Vulcan, we are building the humanist future — tools that empower elected officials to serve the public interest without bureaucratic capture.

Our core belief is this: as AI gets better, our Republic should get better too.

Hey everyone [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

I’m [Abhay](https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhay-kalra-683688214/) – founder of [Avent](https://www.aventindustrial.com/).

# **TL;DR**

**Avent builds the AI inside sales rep for industrial distributors and manufacturers**. Our AI sales rep automates quoting, order entry, and product search so the human sales teams at these companies can spend time with customers again.

**_Ask_:** Can you introduce us **distributors, manufacturers or IMR’s (Independent Manufacturer Reps)**? \
Contact us at [founders@aventindustrial.com](https://mailto:founders@aventindustrial.com)

https://youtu.be/hvfU-DMfRG0?feature=shared

# **📉 The Problem**

I saw firsthand as an operator that growth in distribution is capped almost entirely by hiring. It’s hard to find good sales talent, and even harder to retain.

* Sales teams spend most of their day quoting, entering orders, and chasing product data instead of talking to customers.
* Training new reps takes months, and **more than 50% of the workforce will retire this decade**.
* Critical knowledge lives in inboxes or people’s heads, and disappears when they leave.

The result: companies can’t scale beyond the speed of hiring, while service slows and relationships suffer.

---

# **📈 Our Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93001&key=user_uploads/1006692/0ab6182e-5b8b-4bf9-9d33-3a0a0668e079)

Avent watch every channel where customer requests arrive—email, fax, phone:

* **Quoting:** When a customer asks for a price, Avent finds the correct product and pricing, generates the quote, and prepares it to send.
* **Order Entry:** When the customer follows up with a purchase order (PO), Avent matches it to the earlier quote, creates the sales order, and inputs it into the company’s ledger
* **Procurement:** Never lose an order. If a customer needs something that’s not in stock, Avent will find the best cost from in-network distributors and quote

Avent generates over **$200,000 worth of quotes every day** for distributors across North America and the UK.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93001&key=user_uploads/1006692/74e0b3b9-44b2-42d8-bdeb-e9affaaf7f39)

---

# **The Story**

I grew up in factories, and as kids my older brother and I would spend hours talking about how to take it to the next level. Every brainstorm somehow ended in the same place: _hiring_. Turns out, that wasn’t just our problem. It’s everyone’s problem in distribution.

Avent is what I wish we had back then!

---

launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

Legacy ERPs may run the business for food distributors, but they come at a steep cost - manual order entry alone can consume 10-50 people’s time that should be spent on sales and customer service. Ripping these systems out would take **years**, cost **millions**, and probably spark a small mutiny. Meanwhile, flashy e-commerce storefronts have flopped harder than day-old soufflé.

Burnt deploys AI Agents directly inside these ERPs, starting with a Sales AI Agent that completely replaces the order management job function.

We’re working with large distributors across meat, seafood, and specialty ingredients - 97% of their orders now run end-to-end without people & 90% of order-entry staff shifted into sales.

We’re building supply chain superintelligence so that independent food distributors can compete with the US Foods and Sysco. 

\____________________\_

# **The Problem**

Food distributors that supply restaurants rely on decades-old legacy ERPs - critical to operations but slow, inflexible, and dependent on armies of people to run.

Past attempts to automate these workflows have failed:

* **RPA** works only for structured PDFs, not for the messy reality of food orders coming via emails, calls, texts, WhatsApp, and fax.
* **E-commerce storefronts** have low adoption, 12-24 month implementation cycles and come at a high cost - both financially and emotionally - for distributors, while still failing to address the nuances of the industry.

This leaves distributors buried in manual work. Customer service teams are the perfect example of this issue -  they spend most of their time re-typing orders instead of building relationships.

\____________________\_

# **Our Solution**

https://youtu.be/hRgpT2I1XAk

Burnt’s AI Agents operate inside existing ERPs - no rip-and-replace required.

Our first agent, **Ozai**, monitors all incoming sales channels (email, text, voicemail, WhatsApp, fax – **even phone calls**), learns each customer’s shorthand, habits, and favorite products, interprets prep notes, and enters the order directly into the ERP.

If something’s unclear, Ozai asks the customer for clarification and continues processing without breaking the workflow. The more it sees, the smarter it gets. 

We’re live with some of the most respected independent distributors in the business, who’ve used our AI to double down on customer relationships instead of data entry - all in just a matter of weeks.

\_______________\_

# **Vision**

We’re not just automating order entry anymore - our customers are turning to Burnt, eager for us to take on tasks like automated credit control & procurement.

Our mission? We’re building towards a plug-and-play OS that predicts and executes business decisions before humans need to act.

\_______________\_

We’ve been right there in the thick of it - on factory floors, in seafood markets, and out in the warehouses.

launches.body:
Hey we’re Joe, Jake, and Matthew, cofounders of Luminal. 

Luminal is an [open-source](https://github.com/jafioti/luminal) ML compiler that generates blazingly fast CUDA kernels and makes deploying AI to production one line of code. We’re already powering research at Yale, production workloads at VC-backed startups and several research labs.

https://youtu.be/Rgo15NY9K-8

**TLDR:**

* Our drop-in upgrade to PyTorch automatically generates complex GPU kernel code, like Flash Attention, with zero hand-engineering
* We provide truly serverless deployments; no idle costs or cold starts.
* By not relying on pretrained LLMs or hand-written optimizations, we can reliably speed up any model

**Ask:**

* [Book a meeting](https://calendly.com/accounts-luminalai/30min) if you write PyTorch and want your models to run fast
* [Star us on github](https://github.com/jafioti/luminal) and try Luminal right now on your own laptop!
* Email us if you know someone who runs custom models: [contact@luminalai.com](https://mailto:contact@luminalai.com)

—

### **The problem:**

Most people running their own AI models are lighting money on fire and don’t even know it. AI teams are frustrated when moving their model from dev to production. They either fall into dependency hell or kill their model’s speed. Today, **companies waste millions of dollars on GPU engineering** teams to optimize new models before they can be served to users.\
—

### **How Luminal solves it:**

**Luminal replaces a process that companies pay GPU engineers $300k+ a year to do.**

Our key insight is that by treating optimization as a search problem, we’re able to automatically discover extremely complex optimizations in minutes that would take a GPU expert weeks. We use a series of ‘rewrite rules’ to create millions of graphs to describe your model, generate kernel code for each and then search for the fastest one based on runtime.

_Example of a complicated kernel on the left that Luminal automatically sped up, on the right._

Luminal is:

1. **Closing the research → engineering gap.** Because we auto-generate optimized GPU code directly from your PyTorch, a brand-new model can go from research notebook to production in hours instead of weeks
2. **Writing blazing fast models.** Luminal generates kernels that would take a seasoned GPU engineer weeks of painstaking profiling and tuning to write.
3. **Future-proofing AI for new chips**. We can rerun our compiler on fresh hardware to get new optimal kernels so you're never out of date.

launches.tagline: Real friends, made in real life.
launches.body:
**TL;DR - Answer a few questions, and we’ll match you with new friends IRL for in-person experiences. Friendship guaranteed.**

THE PROBLEM:

Making friends as an adult is hard. Women lose half of their friends every 7 years, and yet there is no easy way to rebuild those circles. This fundamental problem has led to ⅔ of Americans regularly feeling lonely to no fault of their own.

THE SOLUTION:

We know that friendships form when three ingredients align: 1) compatibility, 2) repeat encounters, and 3) authentic conversations. That’s why we designed RealRoots to reliably deliver all three, allowing us to guarantee friendships.

* **Friendship compatibility:** We ask women a questions about her life stage and values, matching with with compatible new friends in her area
* **Repeat Encounters:** When a woman joins RealRoots, she commits to meeting her friend matches for multiple shared experiences, allowing enough repetition for connection to develop.
* **Authentic Conversations**: RealRoots experiences are led by a trained facilitator, who guides deep conversations and icebreakers so that a woman gets to know her matches intentionally.
* A woman joins for a quarter, a year, or longer.

 

WHY WE’RE BUILDING THIS:

We’re building the product we desperately wished existed. After moving 10 times between us, we’ve repeatedly felt the struggle of rebuilding a community from scratch, and the isolation that follows. We created RealRoots because we want to solve this problem, for ourselves and for every woman seeking genuine connection.

OUR ASK:

**Meet friend matches (women only):** Have any female loved ones who are looking for female community? Spread the word about RealRoots. And if you’re a woman, we’d love to help you [meet your new local friend group](https://www.therealroots.com/).

launches.title: Urdu-speaking AI models — really really desi style
launches.tagline: Authentic Urdu AI voices — from nosey aunties to angry molvis.
launches.body:
We have trained an AI model called Orator, that speaks Urdu with human-like realism. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first model that can speak Urdu in an authentic way: the way everyday people speak Urdu in everyday life.

We have voices from “the whole mohalla“ (entire neighborhood). From angry molvis and nosey aunties, to thailay walas, and burger boys.

**You can experience the voices at [UpliftAI.org](http://UpliftAI.org).** The website will allow you to experience dozens of voices in seconds by just clicking/hovering the circles.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103672&key=user_uploads/1455159/ac1e7d0f-ca3e-4fc0-aac6-4cc61a89797e)

**Making the model**

We have put our heart into this work, and enjoying it more than any work we have ever done in the past.

We started with the map of Pakistan and asked: how do people sound in every district. That gave us the accent list.

Then, we asked ourselves: what are all the unique characters we would interact with in a typical month as we go about our normal life. This gave us our character/persona list.

We then hired a leading voice producer and worked with him to hire voice actors and script writers, and then spent months doing voice recordings in studios in Karachi, Lahore, Quetta and Islamabad.

Once the voices were recorded, then we hired 50 contractors to label data.

The final and the simplest step was the model training. We trained a very small 32M param VITS2 inspired model.

The results are very encouraging.

\- Here is someone creating a story book using our voices: <https://shehryar-stories.up.railway.app/frontend/index.html>

\- Here is me just having fun with it: [https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hammad2_is-your-mom-complaining-about-massi-leaving-ugcPost-7468570160233107457-sbQ5/](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hammad2_is-your-mom-complaining-about-massi-leaving-ugcPost-7468570160233107457-sbQ5/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAQRT3MBhOY-xG4s8JvUtCqBaUrSdpKe93Y)

launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Paloma unifies contracts, service consumption, and customer relationship context so that revenue, success and sales teams can operate from the same ground truth. With everything centralized, you can stay ahead of upsell and churn signals while billing runs smoothly in the background.

https://youtu.be/jav-7qS-S4U

---

### **The Problem**

Fragmented customer context and manual billing kill revenue potential:

* Account managers and customer success don’t have full visibility on which clients to pay attention to for maximizing upsells and minimizing churn
* Complex pricing or custom deals often require manual work to bill accurately, making them hard to support and creating a real barrier to selling

### The Result

* Revenue opportunities slip through the cracks because signals for upsell or renewals aren’t surfaced on time
* Teams don’t have a clear view of what they can upsell or at what price, leading to missed opportunities
* Sales is constrained to “billable” terms, creating friction and slowing execution

The result is a reactive, fragmented go-to-market motion where growth is capped by operational bottlenecks instead of driven by customer opportunity.

---

### **How Paloma Solves It**

Paloma is the AI copilot and system of record for everything that happens after the handshake:

* **Unified ground truth:** Parses contracts, communications, notes and service consumption into one shared customer context for revops, finance and customer success.
* **Surfaces revenue opportunities:** Flags upsells, renewals, churn risks, and usage changes and prioritizes them by impact.
* **Automates billing workflows:** Turns complex terms into billing-ready instructions that run behind the scenes.
* **Works with your stack:** Seamlessly integrates with your CRM, billing software, and data sources to sync context and actions.
* **Human-in-the-loop by design:** You stay in control. Paloma learns from your feedback and gradually automates more over time.

Easily import customer contracts and attach important context in seconds.
